reviews.text: This is a true gem of an apartment in one of the best neighborhoods in Istanbul! You have one of the nicest brunch places in Istanbul basically next door, as well as many other bars and cafes. The main shopping street and other touristic places can be reached walking. The apartment is full of light, sparkly clean and comfortable with fast internet and comfortable seating arrangements. Murat was super responsive and his instructions were clear! I gladly return the next time I’m in Istanbul!

When I saw the reviews, I had very high expectations for this stay.
It was in a great location and the flat looked like the pictures.
There were a few things that didn’t make it the best stay, though.
Unfortunately, the stairwell didn’t have a great smell, like sewage and cigarettes.
Inside the apartment, it unfortunately smelled like cigarettes too, I believe people on the first floor (I think it looked like an office space) people were smoking.
It also seemed like the water was very hard as my face would get red and itchy when I would rinse my face and had to resort to drinkable bottled water.
The place looked good, the host was friendly, but there were some issues.

We really enjoyed our stay. Check-in was really easy thanks to the good instructions. The bed and linens were clean and the bed was comfy as well. Absolutely lovely neighborhood. Good value for money overall. Thanks.

We had a good stay here, Murat was responsive and very quickly got the hot water fixed when we had an issue with it. The beds were a little firm for our taste, and it’s up 3 flights of stairs, but the neighborhood cats are very sweet!

The apartment is described as listed. It's very centrally located to great restaurants and close to the Taksim Square area. Very vibrant neighborhood full of extremely friendly cats and lots of coffee shops. It's easy to access the metro station. Very walkable city. The apartment was very spacious and bright with comfortable beds. We were on the 3rd floor so there were stairs to climb with the luggage which is clearly stated in the apartment writeup. Murat was very flexible about leaving our luggage for an extra couple of hours which we really appreciated. We enjoyed our stay overall.

The host was incredibly helpful during our stay and the property staff were very friendly. The pool and gym were very nice, I just wish the room was slightly better maintained.

The location is on a very busy motorway road with nothing around it however you can walk to the main area in about 15 minutes. My wife and I absolutely loved staying at Tevik’s beautiful home away from home! The apartment offered a great location. My wife and I are big walkers and enjoyed walking most of the attractions Istanbul had to offer (keeping in mind there are a couple of steep walks in between)! description: Enjoy a modern stay in Beyoğlu — close to Taksim! This stylish apartment offers a bedroom, living room, kitchen, and bathroom with heating and seasonal AC (May–Oct). The building has elevators, 24/7 security, a café, and paid social facilities (gym, pool, and sauna). Starbucks and Sheraton City Center Hotel are next door, and you can find us easily by searching “Safezone Homes” on Google Maps 🌿

reviews.text:
We stayed in this apartment for about 4 weeks and really enjoyed our time there. The apartment is spacious, clean, tidy, and very comfortable for a longer stay. It has everything needed for daily life: a fully equipped kitchen, all necessary appliances, a dishwasher, and even a waste disposer.
It was also convenient for working remotely, as there was a proper workspace. The building has a gym, pool, and sauna available for an additional fee. The location is great too: there are many shops, cafes, and restaurants nearby, and Taksim / Istiklal are about 15 minutes away on foot. The walk is uphill, but still manageable and quite pleasant.
The host was very responsive, regularly checked in with us, and was ready to help with anything. Overall, we felt very comfortable and would recommend this place for both short and longer stays.

I had to work remote for a couple of days during my stay - internet was pretty good. There is enough space for two people to work (as there is a very comfortable dedicated desk and you can somewhat improvise a second desk in the kitchen). It was actually the main reason for choosing this place and it fully delivered. I was a bit surprised that entering the building was done only via front desk. A similar situation was for the parking. We got used to it, even enjoyed that there was always someone to say hi when leaving/arriving. Place was very peaceful, seems well suited for both winter and summer season. Host was very nice to us and he offered us clear instructions and helpful advices. There are plenty of places nearby where you can get food and somewhere nearby a non-stop shop in case you’re missing anything. I’d stay again.

reviews.text: Booked this listing pretty last minute and I am so glad I got to stay here for a week! The location is really, really awesome. I had no issues with wifi and the desk facing the window was great for remote work. The only thing was the darkness of the bedroom, it's not as well lit as the picture. If you like a dark room, you will love this bedroom. However if you like more natural lighting, this is something important to note! The building is modern, the elevator was a plus, and there's a cute little shop downstairs (as well as a good pizza restaurant right across the street!). A pretty seamless experience, and again, very interested and communicative host!

Wonderful location, comfortable and clean apartment. The washing machine and pristine bathroom were a great bonus for weary travelers nearing the end of their trip. 😃
There was an occasional banging noise, it sounded like something moving in the wind, but otherwise it was very calm and peaceful.
The host was very responsive.

I loved the appartment. Location, cleanliness, and communication. The fact that there’s an elevator in that area of town is a great plus.
The street is beyond charming, with shops, antique shops, galleries, and cafes. Close to my favorite areas of Istanbul. Clean and modern, while in a an old historical area. The team were super responsive and helpful, and the apartment had everything one needs. Would definitely stay there again.

Eymen is an extremely helpful and welcoming host. From the moment we arrived, he took his time for us and was available at any time during our stay – truly 24/7. He was patient, attentive, and always made sure we felt at home. He even organized a transfer for us, for example to the airport.
The location was also great: safe, lively, with shops just down the street, and easy access to both the city and the beach.
Since we were in town for my cousin’s wedding, we booked several apartments (six in total) with Eymen to accommodate our whole family. Everyone was very happy with the service and appreciated his support.
We can highly recommend Eymen as a host. Thank you very much!

reviews.text: Overall, we had both good & bad experiences. The biggest issue was finding the apartment and internet. Neither we nor our Uber driver could reach the host, and we were dropped off in front of the building but we didnt know if we were at the correct address. Sending the address of the hotel next door or photos of the entrance would help. Check-in was delayed because the previous guests had not left. The internet did not work for the first few days, and although the host refunded us some money and shared updates, it was still a major inconvenience. We stayed about 15 days, but there were not enough supplies (a few toilet paper, 1 paper towel, 1 garbage bag, no cooking oil at all ), so we had to buy our own. Shower temperature kept turning extremely hot, making showers frustrating. There is no elevator, and the apartment is on the fourth floor. The host responded quickly and brought extra sheets when asked, but overall, the stay was not worth the price we paid.

We enjoyed our stay at Yücel’s place. The location near Taksim Square is excellent, conveniently on a quiet side-street with plenty of restaurants nearby and easy access to transit. The host provided clear instructions and was responsive whenever we needed anything. The apartment was also clean upon arrival.
The main downside was noise from the people staying upstairs, who were often very loud late into the evening, making it difficult to get good sleep on some nights. The kitchen was also missing a microwave, which was surprising considering it otherwise had most amenities you would expect.
Despite these issues, we had a good stay and appreciated the convenience of the location and the host’s communication.

Place was good , as described in the post , clean and beautiful white theme . Host is very helpful and understanding. Nice location , walkable distance from Taksim square .. Lot of eateries around . Basically value for money ❤️

Merves place was as described. The location was very good since it was a short Tram ride away from the main attractions yet far enough so that the prices at the downstairs store and fruit market were not as high as in the more touristy places. There was not much noise during the night which positively surprised me. the black out curtains are white so if you're sensitive and need it very dark at night consider bringing an eye mask.
Merve was quick to reply and very helpful. Check in was flexible and Merve even offered us to enter a little earlier. I would definitely recommend the Appartment for tourists.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The location was fantastic, it’s on a very quiet street, but at the same time the neighborhood is full of restaurants with all kinds of cuisine. We definitely recommend staying in Taksim, as it’s a lively area and very well connected.
Getting around the city was very easy. You can use the metro, but we often walked about 10 minutes to the tram, which works very well. The walk itself is very pleasant and allows you to enjoy how beautiful the city is.
The apartment is very spacious, the beds are extremely comfortable, and the temperature inside was perfect. During the colder months, it’s especially important to have good heating and reliable hot water, and both worked perfectly.
Tuana, the host, was very attentive the whole time and helped us with everything we needed. She even organized our airport transfers, which are definitely worth it if you want a smooth and stress-free trip to or from the airport.
We would absolutely stay here again.

description: This is a recently renovated, south facing 2bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment. Very central spot where you can walk to Caddebostan seashore, Goztepe Park and Bagdat Avenue in less than 10 mins. In the middle of cafe/restaurants, markets and shops yet quietly located, looking at the back yard. Very secure neighborhood and building.

reviews.text:
It was a great stay in Istanbul, in my favorite Asian area. If you’re looking for a not-Touristic neighborhood - then it’s definitely for you. There are lovely breakfast places around as well as coffee shops and a huge grocery store. I like the park nearby and the seafront is lovely
Super responsive host, nice apartment (exactly as on the pictures). It could give the ‘old’ vibe but I guess it’s more like antique and the kitchen is super modern. We liked warm heated floor, nice for a crawling baby
I have stayed with a kid and faced only 2 minor problems: 1) the apartment is located ‘between’ the floors (Host told me in advance, tho) - it was not that nice to carry the stroller every time; eg. alone I won’t be able to make it; 2) the bathroom is a bit smelly (I faced this before in this area so I think it’s a common problem not specific for this apartment): could be annoying, we had to keep the bathroom door closed always
Other than that - perfect, highly recommended:)
The house was clean, comfortable and we felt safe. Location is great however we had a car and had a lot of difficulty finding a parking space every night. Great place if you don't have a car.

Great apartment in a lovely neighborhood!
The apartment was clean and exactly as shown in the pictures. No surprises at all.
The location is great; very walkable, with many cafes and restaurants nearby. Caddebostan seashore is just a short walk away, perfect for a morning run or simply enjoying the fresh air and the view. Goztepe Park is also close by if you want to relax outdoors. Bagdat Avenue, a great shopping street, is right around the corner.
The only thing to keep in mind is that getting to the European side of Istanbul takes some time, so it may not be the best choice if you plan to go there often.
Overall, a great stay. I would definitely recommend!

Melis is a great host, always responsive and helpful. The location is amazing if you would like to experience how locals live in Istanbul, easy access to the sea, amazing cafes & restaurants, just a short distance to the princeas island's port.
the only thing you need to keep in mind is the wifi connection strength. if you need to work from home, the internet connection is not the strongest but it is somehow managable

I loved my stay at Melis’s gorgeous apartment—stylish, immaculate, and filled with natural light. The neighborhood was fantastic, with a string of excellent restaurants just steps away, and the coastline was a pleasant stroll. Melis was responsive and welcoming throughout. Highly recommend!

description: Enjoy a peaceful stay in this calm, stylish and quiet place. Istanbul's oldest historical district, Beşiktaş, is active 24 hours a day with its cafes, restaurants, shopping malls. Our house is 10 minutes walking distance to the center of Beşiktaş. If you want to explore Istanbul, you can easily reach all tourist areas by bus, ferry, tram, metro connections from the center of Beşiktaş. Your host will be happy to share all his/her experiences with you.

reviews.text: I recently had a wonderful stay in Beşiktaş, Istanbul. The location was absolutely perfect, allowing us to explore the vibrant neighborhood easily. The apartment was clean and well-maintained, providing a comfortable place after a day of sightseeing. What stood out the most was the warm and friendly welcome we received, making us feel right at home. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to experience the charm of Istanbul!

The space is very homely. Nice hot shower. Fully-equipped kitchen. The street is quiet generally and at night. Communication with Kemal was super. The location at the top of Besiktas is great, there's a cool park nearby and 5 minutes to Besiktas centre & 20 minute walk to Nisantasi.

Ev sahipleri her şeyi en ince ayrıntısına kadar düşünmüşler, buzdolabında meyve tabağından, yataklara bıraktıkları minik jelibonlara kadar minik hediyeler ve ihtiyaçlarımızın hepsi önceden düşünülmüş, tertemiz ve düzenliydi. Biz genellikle UV ışığı ile kontroller yaparız ve ışınlar altında bile çarşaflar, yataklar, koltuk ve mutfak tertemizdi. Konum olarak Beşiktaş çarşıya yürüme mesafesinde, yakında marketler, güzel bir park ve tekel var. Ayrıca otobüs duraklarına da yakın. Sadece çok fazla yokuş var valizler ile yürümek için zorlayabilir. Bina içi merdivenlerinde korkuluk yok, dar ve biraz dik. Biz bu konuda bir sıkıntı yaşamadık. Ev sahipleri çok ilgili, kibar ve kolay ulaşılabilir. Kesinlikle tavsiye eder, teşekkürlerimi sunarım.

The house is very clean and well furnished
The host was hospital
The location is in center of Beskitas but in a slope street with a lot of stairs it’s important to know it
For us it was a problem because my mom have a problem in their legs
But in general everything was well and the host was very understanding

Mükemmel bir konaklama ve olağanüstü bir ev sahibi olan Kemal Bey her zaman bize yardımcı olmak için hazırdı.
Kendi kendine giriş çok kolaydı.
Daire tertemizdi ve ilan edildiği gibiydi.
Beşiktaş'taki konumu, turistik yerlere yakın ve şehrin her yerine (otobüs, feribot vb.) kolay erişim sağlıyor.
Konfor: Yatak rahattı, mutfak iyi donanımlıydı; her ayrıntıyı düşünmüşler, hiçbir şey eksik değildi.
Daireyi özellikle güzel dekoru ve ambiyansı (geleneksel Türk evi, sabahın sessizliği ve martı sesleri) nedeniyle çok beğendik. Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyoruz ve kesinlikle tekrar geleceğiz.

description: 100 meters to the metro, Nişantaşı is 2 minutes away, taksim is within walking distance

reviews.text: Ben ve ailem için son derece keyifli bir muhitte yer alan New Hoyel Harbiye, ulaşımı kolaydı. Oda tertemiz ve tüm aradığımız ihtiyaçlar bulunmaktaydı. tee ki ipinden diş fırçasına, havlusuna kadar her şey bulunmaktaydı. Otel ve oda içi tertemizdi. Ev sahibi çok nazikri. 7/24 resepsiyonda ilgili ve güler yüzlü birini bulmak mümkün. Bir daha İstanbul'a gidişimde kesinlikle tercih edeceğim bir yer. Fiyatı da diğer yerlere göre çok çok iyi. Herkese öneriyorum. Ev sahibine çok teşekkürler.
oda temizdi mesafeli bir iletişim vardı güzeldi.ama keşke kahvaltıda olsaydı.bu fiyata sadece oda biraz fazla geldi.
Konum olarak çok iyi, check-in sıkıntısı yok. Oda da temizdi. Teşekkürler

Konumu itibariyle metroya çok yakın, sessiz ve huzurlu bir muhitte bulunan otel Harbiye askeri müzesine 5 dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde. Müze haricinde çeşitli lokanta ve alışveriş merkezlerine de oldukça yakın. Kaldığımız oda oldukça temizdi ve işletmecileri çok ilgiliydi.
Room was clean and comfortable.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: The hotel was clean, the host was very helpful in answering all the questions. The location is closely located to Aksaray Metro- worth the booking

Bu konaklama yeri yeni açılan ve her konuda yardımcı olan personeller tarafından işletilmekte. Kendileri aynı zamanda mahallenin bakkalını da işlettikleri için tahta kaşık bile istediğimde gönderdiler ve bize yardımcı oldular. Özelikle Mehmet beye ilgilisi ve alakası için teşekkür ediyorum burası tarihi yarımada diye adlandırılan bölgede olup Sultanahmet ,Kapalıçarşı, Ayasofya , Yenikapı İdo , ve Yenikapı metro Marmaray gibi yerlere yürüme mesafesinde olup ulaşım açısından çok merkezi bir yerde. Ayrıca içerde netflix gibi hizmetlerde mevcut evde keyifli ve huzurlu vakit geçirdik. Banyo ve odalar tertemizdi müşteriler olduğumuz için fiyatı da çok uygundu yolum buraya düşerse konaklayacağım tek yer. Gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz ailecek işletiyorlar kardeşleride çok saygılı ve yardımsever.

Enjoyed staying here. The room was very clean (did not smell like smoke), shower had hot water, night time was quiet, bed was comfortable, and Internet worked great.
The area was safe, and the location was excellent. Easy to walk to all the surrounding tourist attractions, or there’s a metro station nearby to go anywhere in Istanbul.
Easy checkin process. Owners were super nice and friendly and spoke basic English. I would stay here again. I highly recommend.

We were welcomed very warmly and kindly. We arrived before the check-in time, but our room was cleaned and prepared very quickly for us. The room was clean, tidy, and had beautiful furniture. The dishes and kitchen area were also very clean and pleasant, so it was nice to cook there.
They brought a baby crib for our infant, which we really appreciated. Special thanks to the cleaning lady for the cleanliness and care — she also brought blankets and other things for the baby. And many thanks to both reception managers, they were very friendly and caring. We always had tea and coffee available, and we were also able to do laundry.
We left with very warm and pleasant impressions. A cozy and lovely hotel! 🌸

konum olarak yeni bir sokak ve semtte degil ama ulasimi kolaydi. konumundan dolayi soru isaretlerimiz vardi ama bina ici yeni dizayn edilmis ve her sey yeni ve tertemizdi.
ısıtması oldukca iyiydi. havlular carsaflar gibi ihtiyaclar da temizdi. oldukca cesitli mutfak malzemesi vardi ve onlar da yeni ve temizdi.
tv izleyebilecegimiz her uygulama vardi.
2 kisi gayet rahat konakladik. tekrar tercih edebilecegim bir yer.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Ipek is a great host, she allowed us to leave our luggage in some other room in order not to carry it with us. The accomodation is really comfortable. Location is 10 minutes walking to the busiest part of Taksim, 20 min from Galata.

Ev genel anlamda temizdi ve mobilyalar yeniydi. Bu tek olumlu yanı. Konum olarak Taksim 365’e ve İstiklal Caddesine yakın fakat sokak olarak gürültülü ve tenha bir sokaktı. Giriş normal bir süreden uzun sürdü bir kaç kez aradıktan sonra anca ulaşbildim. Çıkış saatimiz gelmeden yarım saat önce kapımız çalındı ve çıkış saati için uyarıldık. Misafir ağırlamak ve arkadaş grubu olarak gidilebilecek bir yer olduğunu düşünmüyorum. Rahat edemediğimizi açıkça söyleyebilirim.

Ev resimlerdekine benzerdi ancak odalar çok küçüktü. Havasızdı cam açmamıza rağmen. Evde terlik yoktu yazdık ancak cevap bile verilmedi. Duş başlığı kırılmıştı bunu da ilettik ancak cevap alamadık. Yerler kirliydi ve terlik olmadığı için rahat edemedik. Evde bir adet su bile yoktu. Asansör amerikan sistemi evin içine açılıyordu. Bu yüzden sürekli aesten dolayı uyandıl. Tek iyi yanı salonunun büyük olması. Gerisi kötü bir tecrübeydi.
Great appartmant and great host. Communication was easy, pur host was helpful. Location is great, near Istiklal street, surrounded by small restourants
very nice place near to everything can walk to taksim square very close Host also nice

description:
Only 5 minutes walking distance to Galataport, 10 minutes walking distance to Galata Tower,
-Consists of 2 bedrooms, open kitchen and living area
-Bedrooms provide privacy with curtains.
-Located on the 3rd floor of the building, no elevator, easy to access
-Fully equipped (Air conditioning, wireless internet connection, dishwasher, automatic coffee machine, hair dryer + iron, vacuum cleaner, kitchen utensils and much more)
-Paid parking is 30 meters away.

reviews.text:
Solid location for going out and about. Place is as described and exactly like the photos. We had an issue with the hot water and the host was responsive and fixed the issue the same day. Can’t say enough good things about the location of the apartment and how easy it is to get to the local Tran and find the happening spots of Karakoy.
One thing to note for future guests. As the description provides there’s no elevator access so if you have luggage you will have to use the stairs. We were on the third floor so that was arduous but you have to keep this in mind. Use google maps to find the exact location (right next to the ice-cream/dessert store)
As a friendly suggestion to the host. I think it would be great if there was an added towel hanger or two for bath towels installed in the bathroom. Other than that the place was exactly what we needed.

Kübra was an excellent host. Her communication and responsiveness was outstanding and I really appreciated that. She gave me recommendations for a Hamam and the place she recommended was excellent. The apartment was a little smaller than the pictures would lead you to believe, but still a workable space. Appreciated the washing machine given we are travelling for a few months. Be warned that the stairs are a tight spiral, so carrying luggage up and down can present a small challenge. While the apartment is certainly in a great location in terms of access to restaurants, bars, and public transport, the noise from the cafes and bars on the ground level (especially the bar) is a lot. Friday and Saturday nights were particularly noisy and made sleeping a challenge. Another challenge was the shower. It would be helpful if the shower head sat more easily in the holder rather than having to go through a balancing game using water pressure to hold it in place.

Ev sahipleri çok yardımseverdi ve mesajlara her zaman hızlı bir şekilde cevap verdiler. Ev çok temizdi ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Check-in süreci çok kolay ve sorunsuzdu. Konumu oldukça merkeziydi, her yere rahat ve hızlı bir şekilde ulaşabildik. Ayrıca fiyatına göre gerçekten çok iyiydi, fiyat-performans açısından oldukça memnun kaldık. Tekrar gelmek isteriz.

I really loved Kubra's place. I stayed there with my two daughters and it was perfect for us. We couldn't have asked for a better location. Lots of bars and restaurants at your doorstep. We walked almost everywhere but there is a tram stop nearby. The beds were super comfortable and the apartment was clean and spacious. I'm a bad sleeper but I slept extremely well here. There were a few small things which could be improved. For example in the shower we could not hang up the shower head so had to hold it while showering. Also, there could be some more hooks to hang up towels. There were two electric outlets which did not look very safe (they were loose on the wall) so we did not use them. Also, there could be a bit more space to store/hang clothes. There was one wardrobe where the bed was with the red curtain with just 5 hangers but not really any place where the big double bed was. Communication was very good with Ayse and WiFi worked perfectly.

The location is top tier, really close to the Galata tower and other surrounding attractions. Clean and cozy spot, would definitely stay here again.
Keep in mind it’s on a 3rd floor and there is no elevator. (for those traveling with larger luggage)
The instructions were extremely clear and made the check in/out experience smooth.
Our point of contact for the stay, Ayşe, was extremely communicative and readily available if we needed anything.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Ev temiz ve düzenliydi bu beni çok memnun etti.Konum olarak ulaşımı gayet rahattı.Eve giriş oldukça kolaydı.Ev sahibi sağolsun erken giriş için yardımcıda oldu. Ev içinde ısıtma klimayla sağlanıyor ancak klima yeterli ısıyı sağlamıyor biraz üşüdük.Genel olarak güzel bir deniyimdi,kesinlikle tercih edebilirsiniz,mutlu ayrıldım.Ev sahibine teşekkürlerimi iletiyorum.

Konumu gayet iyiydi ve dedikleri gibi her tarafa yakındı, rahat bir şekilde ulaşım sağladık. Ayrıca çevrede bulunan restorant ve marketler sayesinde de ihtiyaçlarımızı rahatça karşılayabildik. Evin içi temizdi ve fotoğraflar ile birebir aynıydı. Murat ve Alparslan bey'e de buradan tekrardan teşekkür ediyorum, kendileri başından sonuna kadar yardımcı oldu. Şayet yolunuz İstanbul'a düşerse gönül rahatlığı ile tercih edebilirsiniz.

The location is great, and the apartment is exactly like in the pictures. Check-in and check-out are easy and fast. There was no washing machine though (it was listed as an amenity) and the TV wasn't working. But these are small disadvantages having the mind the location and the price of the place. The place is definitely a good choice.

Gerçekten beklentilerimin çok üstündeydi! Evin temizliği, düzeni ve dekorasyonu mükemmeldi. İçeri adım attığım an, bir otel konforuyla ev sıcaklığını aynı anda hissettim. Her şey düşünülmüş, eksiksizdi. Konaklama boyunca bir kere bile “Acaba?” demedim. Ev sahibi de işini severek yapan, misafirperver ve yardımsever biri; iletişimimiz çok rahattı. Lokasyon da çok iyiydi, hem ulaşım kolaydı hem de çevrede ihtiyaç duyulacak her şey vardı. Kısacası, “iyi ki” dedirten bir deneyim oldu. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ediyorum.
5 yıldız bile az!

This is definitely the best place I stayed at in Istanbul — super clean, tidy, and well-organized.
What I loved most was the sea view. You can see the blue ocean right from the window when you wake up, and it’s especially beautiful when the sunlight hits the water and makes it sparkle.
There’s also an A101 just a 5-minute walk away, which is super convenient for grabbing cheap food and groceries on the way back.
Highly recommended!

description: Our apartments, which are located at a common point within walking distance to Galataport, Galata Tower, Karaköy, Taksim and İstiklal Street, provide convenience to other districts and places you want to visit with the proximity of public transportation.

reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week here with our family. The apartment is incredibly well located in the heart of the Galata neighborhood, close to everything: public transport, restaurants, shops, and all the must-see spots in Istanbul. The location couldn’t be better !
The apartment was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Our host was extremely friendly, responsive, and welcoming, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
I highly recommend this place and we hope to return inshallah!

I’ve traveled to over 35 countries and stayed in many Airbnb properties, but this experience with Mr. Saltanat was truly exceptional. He was extremely polite, respectful, and responsive—he replied within seconds! Although check-in was at 3 PM, I arrived at 10 AM and he quickly cleaned the apartment and welcomed me warmly. He even helped with my luggage and checked in daily to see if I needed anything. The location is perfect—just a 10-minute walk to Taksim, 2 minutes to the Metro, and 3 minutes to the sea. Supermarket and bakery are right in front. Great price. I I lost the apartment key accidentally, I offered him money, but he said “No way”. He told me consider the apartment your own, I was very embarrassed from him, how wonderful he is….if you go to Istanbul, Mr. Saltanat is your first option. The TV has Netflix, and all the equipment that you need are available.
I give this place 100 stars, not just 5. Highly, highly recommended!

Yazıp çizmeyi çok becerebilen bir insan değilim o yüzden kısa ve öz şekilde yazacağım.Önceliğim kesinlikle ev sahibi Kerem Bey.Gerçekten şu hayatta tanıyabileceğiniz nadir insanlardan birisi.Çok yardımsever çok kibar çok samimi içten yani anlayacağınız her şeyin çok fazlası.Burdan tekrar tekrar teşekkürlerimi sunuyorum kendisine.Ev fotoğraftaki gibi temiz ve güzeldi.Konum olarak çok iyi noktada kolaylıkla istediğiniz yerlere ulaşım sağlayabilirsiniz.Hiç düşünmeden gidip kalabilirsiniz.İstanbul'a yolum düştüğünde artık hep buradayım.Kesinlikle diğer evlere bakmam bile.

“Absolutely Wonderful Stay – Highly Recommend!”
I had the pleasure of staying at Aykut Airbnb, and it was truly one of the best experiences I’ve had! From the moment I booked, Aykut was incredibly responsive, making sure I had all the information needed for a smooth check-in.
The space itself is nicely decorated. It felt like a home away from home, with thoughtful touches The bed was comfortable, and the ambiance was perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. The location is EXTREMELY GOOD and it’s easy to get around. One of the best gems is the mini market across the street opened until 1-2 am.
One thing that stood out was how attentive and friendly Aykut is. He is extremely friendly and there is hardly any better host than him. Also he provided recommendations for local spots, restaurants, and hidden gems that I would have never found on my own. It’s clear that Aykut has the best taste to treat people and making them feel amazingly happy. Don’t hesitate. Just click and book
The apartment is exactly like the photos. You have everything you need. We stay one week and it was perfect. Really easy to go by walk or by common transport to the main touristics attraction.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Ş. Sezai’s place for two weeks in April 2026, and it had everything we needed for a comfortable group stay. Ş. Sezai maintained excellent communication throughout, and it’s easy to see why he is recognized as a superhost. The apartment was very clean and comfortable.
The location, in the historic part of Istanbul, is very convenient. Taksim Square—an important transport hub - is just a short walk away, making it easy to reach virtually any point of interest in the city by bus or metro. There are also many supermarkets and cafés nearby. For groceries, I recommend the BIM supermarket on the same street, about 300 meters away, which offers everything you need at low prices. You can even spot its red sign from the window near the elevator on the 9th floor. The building’s sauna and swimming pool were also a nice bonus.
Overall, this property offers excellent value for a reasonable price. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

We had a great stay! The place looked exactly like the photos, which we really appreciated. All the rooms had air conditioning, making the stay very comfortable. The location was also convenient and close to the city centre.
Free parking was provided exactly as mentioned in the description, which was very helpful for us. Overall, everything matched the listing well, and we had a comfortable and pleasant experience. Would definitely recommend!

The perfect quality/cost balance.
The landowner has been extremely helpful in fixing an issue I had with my car before coming to Istanbul. He not only put me in contact with a garage, but also made sure the work done and the price would be correct.
The appartement corresponds to the description. Air conditioning helps during Summer time.
The swimming pool was much appreciated, even if sometimes guests of other appartements were a bit exited.
You can easily reach all parts of the city by bus which stations are less than 10 min walk from the appartement. You can also find restaurants and shops 5 minutes walk from the appartement.
We would definitively book the appartement again if we come back to Istanbul
The reception was very helpful each time needed.

The flat is spacious with 3 bedrooms situated on the top floor. The downstairs bedroom and living room are a bit noisy due to the sliding doors that offer little sound proofing, but the upstairs bedrooms are a good choice if you are a light sleeper. Mind that there is a bar right across the street that plays very loud music on weekends, but they do stop at around 12. The building has a pool that is excellent for exercising, but is a bit cold if you are just looking to relax. There is also a gym right next to the pool, and both amenities are really good. Shopping at the local groceries is very expensive, and I would recommend going up to the main street to the left and shopping at the small supermarket in stead. There is an excellent cafe going upwards to the Taksim square called Boheme that serves great coffee and some bakes. There is also a really good restaurant going up to the square that serves traditional Turkish food. The host is very agreeable and will help with all you need.

Good access to public transport. Good , hot showers, however there was an unpleasant smell in one bathroom.
We had a very early flight and were able to check in early. The host organized for the apartment to be cleaned early to accommodate us. This was most appreciated!

description: The hotel is located in the historical center of Istanbul. Many places are within walking distance. Suleymaniye Mosque is 5 minutes away on foot, Spice Bazaar and Grand Bazaar are 7 minutes away, Hagia Sophia and Sultanahmet Mosque are 12 minutes away. Therefore, you can walk to many historical places. Metro 2 and tram are 2 minutes walk away. Therefore, you can reach anywhere. You can reach the ferries on foot in 5 minutes. There are markets and restaurants around my hotel.

reviews.text:
Terrible experience. The room we received did not match the listing photos at all. It was extremely cramped and had no exterior window. Instead, there was only a small window facing the brightly lit internal hotel hallway, so our room was flooded with light all night. There was also constant, loud noise from the neighboring room's bathroom ventilation, making sleep completely impossible.
Furthermore, the bed linens and towels were heavily stained and dirty. We reported this immediately, but despite promises, the host never changed them. When we asked for an alternative room, the host refused. We had to check out after just one sleepless night and book another hotel at our own expense. Avoid this place at all costs.

Great location, and the host was very responsive and helpful. The bathroom was clean, and everything you need was provided: a kettle, shampoo, towels, and a hairdryer. The only thing that could be improved a little is the cleanliness of the bed sheets. Other than that, everything was great!

Çok keyifli bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Yusuf Bey gerçekten çok cana yakın ve ilgili biriydi. Otelin konumu oldukça iyiydi, ulaşımı kolaydı ve bulmakta hiç zorlanmadık. Oda ve banyo gayet temizdi. Fiyat performans açısından kesinlikle başarılı bir yerdi.
Gece istediğimiz saatte giriş yapabilmemiz ve anahtarımızı emanet bırakabilmemiz büyük kolaylık sağladı. Oda biraz küçük olsa da bizim için yeterliydi ve konfor açısından herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık.
Her şey için Yusuf Bey’e teşekkür ederiz, kesinlikle tavsiye edilir.
The Airbnb was clean and in a hotel building. The space was small, the Wi-Fi didn’t work well, and it was a bit noisy, but overall it was okay for a short stay.

It was great and affordable place. The location was suitable and the staff were nice. The place had a couple bugs (flies and mosquitoes, probably because of the hot weather) but overall it was a clean place (clean sheets, pillow cases, bathroom etc) and the staff helped taking care of the bugs. I would recommend this property for visitors that are looking for a calm, reachable and affordable place.

description:
1+1 Clean Residence Apartment in a Central Location in Ataköy

Our modern and spacious residence apartments, located in the center of Istanbul, just a few steps from the Yenibosna metro and Metrobus stop, offer a comfortable accommodation experience. It is the perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers in the city.

An ideal environment with its location close to shopping centers, supermarkets, health tourism, hospitals and cafes.
Get away from the busy pace of the city and enjoy the center at the same time.

reviews.text: Very clean and comfortable unit, great location with store and restaurants directly downstairs. Host is very nice. Thank you again.
Clean and comfortable place, great location with shops and restaurants nearby. Easy to get around and the host was friendly and responsive. Thanks alot.

Konum olarak gayet merkezi, hemen hemen bütün ulaşım yollarına yakın. Rezidansın altında ve yanındaki AVM ile birçok ihtiyacınızı herhangi bir yere gitmeden karşılayabilirsiniz. Ev gayet temizdi ve ev sahibi bizim için giriş saatinde esneklik sağladı. Her şey için teşekkürler.

Nasrettin was extremely accommodating and helpful. My flight was delayed and he came out to let me into the apartment at 2am in the morning. Always contactable, polite and responsive to any needs or questions I had. Apartment is clean, tidy and has everything you need. Highly recommended.

Its wonderful place if you are 3 person , the location is superb near to mall and megros big super market , surrounded is also good and the Host Mr Faisal is very cooperative and nice person and always allow flexible check in and check out

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text: Evde bir hafta kaldık. Annemin ameliyat olacağını temizlik anlamında çok hassas olduğumuzu net bir şekilde belirtmiştim ev sahibine. Lakin içeriye girdiğimizdeki manzara pek öyle değildi. Ev sadece düzenliydi. Koltuklar leş gibi kokuyordu halılar pisti üzerlerinde lekeler vardı. Ya zaten terliksiz gezmedik yani öyle diyeyim. Televizyon konusunda ev sahibinden bayağı yardım istedim ama pek ilgilenmedi kablolu yayın olmadığını söyledim ya da biz bulamadık dedim, var dedi ve umursamadı. Buzdolabı bozuktu içi leş gibi kokuyordu onu söyledik daha sonrasında ilgilendi en azından dolap yapıldı. Çamaşır makinesi kafasına göre çalışıyordu. Koyulan tencereler kırıktı içleri yemek yapılmayacak durumda simsiyah olmuştu. Camlar o kadar kirliydi ki dışarı net görünmüyordu. Evi resmen ben temizledim. İyilik olarak evin hemen kapısının önünde metro var ulaşım anlamında efsane bir yer. Muhiti iyi ama gürültülü. Eve 5 üzerinden 2 verebilirim. Tekrar tercih etmem için düzenlemeler gerekli

I don’t recommend this place to anyone!!
We were given different apartment which looks worst than advertised pictures. Stain and cigarette burns on the couch and the carpets. Broken bed frame and headboard. The entire apartment smells smoke. Luckily we only stayed for a night. Never do it again.
The owner will ask for your number and leave the chat to talk to you in private. So he can offer you other places not advertised.
nir kaç gğn konaklama yaptık ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi fotoğraflarla aynıydı teşekkür ederiz.
Nice place and nice host. I made mistake when doing reservation, host fixed it very fast and without any problems

Very good accommodation, clean, private, and overall a good place.
Thank you Ismail for your hospitality.
I’d recommend bringing your own towels.

description:
Marmaray: After getting off at Yenikapı station, you can reach our property in just a few minutes' walk.
• Metro: Take the M1 (Airport-Kirazlı) or M2 (Hacıosman) line and get off at Yenikapı station.
• Tram: You can get off at the Aksaray stop on the T1 (Bağcılar-Kabataş) line and reach our street after a short walk.
• IETT: All bus routes from all over the city that pass through Aksaray stops are suitable for transportation.

reviews.text: Temiz, konforlu, ulaşım konusunda çok rahat edeceğiniz konumda olan bir ev. Ev sahibi mesajlara anında dönüş sağlıyor ve bir saat erken giriş yapma isteğimizi kırmadı. Her şeyiyle dört dörtlük bir konaklama deneyimiydi, teşekkür ederiz.
Host çok yardımcıydı. Konakladığımız ev çok temiz ve merkeziydi. Metroya ulaşım çok kolay. Eve giriş ve çıkışta iletişim çok hızlıydı.
Fiyat performans açısından mükemmeldi. Temiz ve bakımlı bir odaydı. Günü birlik ya da 2-3 günlük konaklama için ideal.
Beklediğim gibiydi temiz ve rahat
It was a good place near train station.

description:
The flat is newly renovated completely in January 2025

250 meters ( 5 minute walking ) to Palace of the Porphyrogenitus,
400 meters ( 7 minute walking ) to the seaside.
550 meters to Balat bazaar district ( where iconic tavern of "Agora Meyhanesi 1890" is )

reviews.text:
Stayed there for 3 weeks, the host was great. Quick responses, if we needed something, he helped us right away. Place is clean and comfortable. Looks exactly like the pictures.
The area is a little hilly but it's more than walkable. There's not much of a view from the windows but if you want a view, it's within a 3 minute walk.
Overall, very enjoyable stay and a great host.

The stay is in a location close to Balat street. Mr. Kaan was really helpful and did daily follow-ups to make sure everything was going well during our stay. Fatih is also within walking distance, you can find plenty of restaurants there. The metro station is also easily accessible on foot.
Overall, a great location and a comfortable stay. 😊

Kaan is an excellent host, highly responsive, flexible, and easy to communicate with. The place is immaculately clean, exuding a charming atmosphere and well-furnished. While the neighborhood may appear a bit intimidating, it is remarkably safe. We stayed out until 3-4 a.m. without feeling any sense of unease or insecurity. However, the location is in a noisy area and somewhat challenging to reach by car. It’s a 15-minute walk to the nearest transportation station (Ayvansaray), which has steep uphill and downhill sections. Additionally, there’s a mosque nearby that loudly calls the adhan five times a day.
Considering its distance from Taksim, I might not book this place again. Nevertheless, we had a pleasant stay there.
Clean room and good communication. Just location on the hill, which is 500m from the main road. And Khan's communication is so fast. I recommend you to stay there.

Le logement était très propre, bien équipé et facilement accessible. Il dispose de tout le nécessaire : eau, wifi, plaque de cuisson, vaisselle, séchoir et fer à repasser.
Le logement est idéal pour un couple ou une personne seule. Personnellement, j’y ai séjourné seule et j’avais quelques appréhensions concernant le quartier, mais tout s’est très bien passé. Les voisins sont gentils, respectueux et bienveillants.
La station de tramway Ayvansaray se trouve à seulement 10 minutes à pied, et le quartier de Balat à 15 minutes.
J’ai passé un excellent séjour. Merci beaucoup, Mr Kaan, pour votre accueil et votre professionnalisme.

description: The place is walking distance to Asmalımescit, Beyoglu, Sishane and Taksim and at the same time is at a quite neighborhood. It has great view of Golden Horn and Old City with a nice terrace. The building was completed 3 years ago matching an original characteristic building with high ceilings. It is in a safe neighborhood and has 24 hour security. The flat comes with all necessary appliances, modern furniture and equipment.

reviews.text: This place is very centrally located, and close to Galata area. (walking distance about 15mins walk). The street is nice and you have an amazing view from the balcony on the Bosporus river and the mosques. The appartement is super nice and was remarkably clean. It’s a very stylish place and you will enjoy staying there pretty much. We were a family of 4 and we all had enough space. The 2 bedrooms are very spacious, the living room with open kitchen is big enough to spend time there, while others can have privacy in the bedrooms. The kitchen is very modern and well equipped. The bathroom is big with a shower, washing machine and toilette. There is also a second seperate toilet, which is very convenient when you are more than a couple. The communication with the host is very easy and super fast. Unfortunately we couldn’t meet the host, but the security staff in the building took care of us. They are very friendly and helpful. There is also an elevator in the building, which is great when travelling with heavy luggage, children and people with reduced mobility. In overall, I can only recommend this place.

Квартира просто шикарная, ни разу не снимали ничего подобного. Кажется, что живешь в апартаментах квартирного типа какого-то дорогого отеля. Высоченные потолки, 4 метра, чистый новый ремонт, идеальная огромная ванная с душем, два туалета, две просторные спальные. Во всех помещениях кондиционеры. Техника на кухне установлена дорогая, немецкая. Удобнейший диван, на котором вечерами с друзьями отдыхали и пили вино. Есть стиральная машина, утюг, сушилка, чайник, бокалы и прочее. Маловато хозяйственных расходников: нет порошка, салфеток, мыла. Это всё докупили сами, но это не сложно и не дорого.
Балкон чудесный, узкий, но с видом и столиком. Мы, вчетвером, на нем идеально помещались. Днем и утром просто красота! Пили на балконе вино, фотографировались, смотрели чаек и ловили солнышко!
Рядом с квартирой есть круглосуточный магазинчик. В нем фрукты и всё по мелочи, не супермаркет, но норм. Есть алко-магазин, но он до 21:00 вроде работает. Квартира в шаговой доступности от самой известной прогулочной улочки с магазинами. Так же она недалеко от пирса(20-25 минут пешком), от куда уходят катера на азиатскую часть и на острова. Такси UBER сюда легко доезжает. Мы вообще им пользовались постоянно. Чтобы доехать до центральной площади и мечети Софии уйдет 20 лир (примерно 300₽).
В здании постоянно дежурит помощник, он всегда всё подскажет. Вообщем, за эти деньги потрясающее жильё!
__________
This apartment is really gorgeous, never stayed anywhere like that. It seems that you are staying in a family apartment of some expensive hotel. High ceilings, at about 4 meters, clean new renovation, perfect huge bathroom with shower, two toilets, two spacious bedrooms.
All rooms have air-conditioners. Kitchen appliances are expensive, Miele.
The most comfortable sofa on which we had rest and drank wine. There are washing machine, iron, dryer, kettle, glasses etc. But there weren’t enough household things like: washing powder, napkins, soap, but it's not a problem to buy it by yourself.
The balcony is wonderful, narrow, but with a great view and nice cozy table. Four people perfectly placed on it. Perfect balcony. We Drank wine on the balcony, photographed, watched the seagulls and caught the sun!
Next to the apartment there is a convenience store. It is not a supermarket, but you can buy there some fruits. There is an alcohol store, but it works until 21:00. The apartment is within walking distance of the most famous street with shops. It is also near the pier (20-25 minutes on foot), from where the boats leave to the Asian part and to the islands. Taxi UBER here easily reaches. We used it all the time. To get to the Sultanahmet square and the mosque of Sofia will take 20 lire (approximately 300₽).
In general, for this money, amazing apartment!

Here is what to really expect:
1. The pictures absolutely do not match what the Airbnb looks like. I came in and was confused because 70% of the furniture was changed. I told the host this and all he said was that the old furniture in the listing was dirty so he changed it. ( FALSE advertisement). The aesthetic with the new furniture is definitely not nice. It’s dark blue and gray furniture that are smaller and not comfortable at all. His attitude was “ a couch is a couch” not taking responsibility for the false advertisement.
2. The host wasn’t very communicate and the manager he put in charge was very aggressive. He wasn’t hospitable at all.
3. The AC is very weak in the living room, we even thought it was broken.
4. Last but not least there was BED BUGS. I slept only for 1hr and woke up to bed bugs all throughout the bed. I jumped up in terror, grabbed my bags and packed. I immediately took pictures and videos which I wish I could share on here. It was DISGUSTING. I have never felt that type of terror in an Airbnb. The manager came to check it out and all he said was that there wasn’t any even though I showed so many pics and videos. I didn’t sleep longer than one hour and we left the premise as sooon as we got the okay from Airbnb.
I would’ve left a higher review if the host refunded that night but again, his attitude is “ a house is a house”. I don’t think I could ever stay in an Airbnb after this experience. How could you not give a full refund when we only slept an hour and you put us through that terror? Unacceptable. Beware and do not risk bed bugs bites for an Airbnb that doesn’t even match the pictures anymore!

I really liked the apartment. The view is impressive. Kitchen is well equipped. Beds are comfortable. New furnished. 2nd floor with elevator. Near by few groceries and bakery.
Ergin was responding quickly on communication prior and post the bookong is confirmed. Was able to check in couple of hours early. Yaşar the security man welcomed us and was always offering help and checking if anything is needed.

Great value! Fantastic view and a nice location. The apartment was very clean and for a party of four very comfortable. I would recommend to anyone that is ok with a mosque close by. The doorman that helped us check in and out was very helpful and everything went smoothly.

description:
Luxury Accommodation with Panoramic Sea and City Views

Experience the perfect blend of history and modern comfort in this stylish apartment, offering breathtaking panoramic sea and city views in Sisli İstanbul Turkiye. Just minutes away from popular neighborhoods and historical landmarks, discover a new way of life with this stunning view as your backdrop.

reviews.text: Daire her yönüyle mükemmeldi. Temizlik ve düzen konusunda oldukça başarılıydı. Ev sahibi hoş bir şekilde bizi karşıladı. Evin inanilmaz bir manzarası var. Açıklamalarda belirtilmemiş ama 2 köprüyü ve İstanbul Boğazıni oldukça net bir şekilde görüyor özellikle geceleri harika bir manzarası var. Rezidansta kapali havuz, tenis ve basketbol sahası gibi imkanlar da sunuluyor. Konumu Bomonti Tünele çok yakın olduğu için her yere ulaşım çok rahattı ve taksi bulmakta da zorluk çekmedik. Konaklamayı düşünenler gözü kapalı tercih edebilir.

Seams to be managed by three young guys who don’t seam to have much experience with vacation rentals. I checked into one apartment only to have to be relocated to another one of their apartments in the same building because the first one was very dirty but I realized the second one was just as dirty afterwards and the next day they had to clean it. Not much pots and pans to do any cooking but the apartment was cheap compared to others in the building.
Her şey aynı fotoğraflarda ki gibiydi. Temiz düzenli ve çok merkezi bi konumda.
Nice, clean and quiet apartment with beautiful view of the city. Good wifi.
Fotoğraflarda göründüğünden daha güzel ve keyifli . Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim 🌸

description:
Hello
This studio apartment in the Sultanahmet area is operated by the Maniz tourism company. You can reach the tram stops, Topkapı Palace, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and many other historical buildings in about 10 minutes on foot from our building. There are many markets, laundries, restaurants, pharmacies, taxi stops, etc. around our building. Our building has 4 floors and there is a studio room on each floor. This studio is located on the 2nd floor of our building. We would be happy to have you as our guest.

reviews.text:
This accommodation was fine for us for the few nights we were there, but it was more what we would consider a hotel room than a studio apartment. The “kitchen” was just a sink, hot plate, mini fridge, and microwave. The smaller of the two beds was also very hard, leaving me with a bad crick in my neck. This comes with the territory in Istanbul, but it’s also worth mentioning that the building is on a very steep hill.
All that said, the host was very helpful. Before we knew our exact departure plans, they were willing for us to leave our luggage there after check out time, and ultimately allowed us to check out late.

Clean and convenient place in the heart of İstanbul. Maniz was a great host and responded promptly. We thought we had an issue with the hot water and he sent someone to inspect it right away. The water just needs a little time to come through fully, very hot and high pressure. The stairs may seem challenging at first but were manageable with our 20kg suitcase. Thanks again for hosting us!

loved staying here- it was close to the main area and neighborhood felt safe in the evenings as 2 female travellers. Place was clean and as described, beds were comfortable and kitchen had the basics!Highly recommend!
Very kind and helpful host. Clean place with big bathroom and strong water pressure. The location is very close to whatever one can need. Absolutelly good value for the price.

AMAZING! The place matched the description, comfortable beds, host was accessible and responsive within minutes. Easy check in and check out. The location was key- walkable to most things as well as public transportation! Safe, quiet neighborhood! I will definitely be back!

description:
This private room is located on 2nd floor in a shared flat. Our location is 2 minutes away from Sishane metro station & main Istiklal Avenue surrounded by historical atmosphere of local attractions.

! VERY IMPORTANT NOTE ! Its a shared flat with 3 private single rooms with huge shared kitchen, so only 3 people are sharing this flat. This private room and entire flat is AVAILABLE ONLY FOR FEMALE GUESTS. Please make your request due to this reminder.

Wi-fi speed is 100 MBPS fiber!

reviews.text:
The room is very comfortable for a long stay as there's a closet, shelves and a desk, plus a lot of space to store your food in the kitchen. The apartment itself is very well maintained, and if your stay is long, there's a cleaning service once in a while. I was there in the winter and the heating made it very warm (and if your hang your clothes after washing them, they dry very quickly). Essentially it felt like a warm, cozy bubble in the cold weather :)
The location is very convenient as it's central and very close to many shops and cafes, as well as to the metro. As a solo female traveler I felt very safe coming back at night.
Most importantly, Ali is an extremely attentive and helpful host. Even though we never met in person, everything went smoothly - from my arrival and the clear check-in instructions and throughout my entire stay, as he was always available via WhatsApp. I happened to be sick a few days before I was supposed to leave, and Ali helped me a lot by bringing me medicines and vitamins and by inviting me to stay longer.
It might be worth mentioning (though you can also see it in the picture) that the only window in the room has frosted glass windowpanes, so when it's closed, you barely see anything even with the curtain drawn back. However, you might not always be inclined to open it for long during the day because it's right above a schoolyard (or because of the weather). so essentially you might not see the outside a lot when you're in the room. Just something worth knowing that might not be a big deal for most people :)

I had a wonderful time staying at Ali's place. The apartment is clean and neat. You have nothing to worry about, all the amenities are provided. The neighbourhood is very safe and friendly.
The apartment is in a very accessible area, everything you need is just a walk away. All touristy places are within a walking distance as it is centrally located.
If you are visiting Istanbul for the first time, I would highly recommend this place to stay.
A big thank you to Ali for providing a great and price-worthy stay.
Host was very helpful, and the flat was very clean and tidy. The room was comfortable, and the building is located in a very nice part of Istanbul.

The place is very well located to explore both the main sites and the more alternative Istanbul.

Ali is a great host, his place is clean and looks exactly like the pictures.

This place is clean and very well located. Beyoglu is a wonderful area to stay! You can easily get to Sultanahmet where you find all the must sees. The flat is ecactly as described and it's easy to feel 'home' when you rent it longtime.
Ali is very friendly, respectful and always at hand when you have any questions about the flat or the city.
I highly recommend to stay here!

description: Hello, I am student in Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University. My life is full of art and I worship having connections with different people. I wish we will all enjoy the experience! And hopefully we will have life-long memories all together!

reviews.text:
First of all, big thanks to Esin for her wonderful hospitality! The apartment is in a very central location, just a short walking distance from Istiklal Street, right in the heart of Istanbul. You can easily access public transportation and get anywhere you need to go.
Since it’s on the top floor of a building with only one apartment per floor, the place has a beautiful view and is very airy. Even without air conditioning, the breeze coming through the windows kept the apartment cool and comfortable the whole time. I never missed having a fan or AC.
The apartment was clean, well-organized, and equipped with everything you might need. There’s also an adorable, friendly cat named Seto living in the house. He’s not mischievous, very calm, elegant, and adds a lovely energy to the home.
All in all, it was a very comfortable and peaceful stay for me. I’m so glad I chose this place over a soulless hotel room 😊 I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Esin was very hospitable. I arrived later than arranged, after midnight, and she still waited up. Even when dealing with unexpected events in her own life, she made sure I was comfortable.
The cat was grumpy at first, but we got along.
It's a small apartment, full of books and art. No bathtub; but shower good. Sometimes cramped and inconvenient, but I enjoyed it.
You need to be fit to stay here. 6th floor, no elevator, a sloped street and you'll be carrying up your drinking water, because Istanbul tapwater isn't potable.
A fantastic neighbourhood to chill and hang out: shops, cafés, baker, small businesses, and a lively Sunday market just round the corner.
Not much English spoken, so learn a few phrases. (E.g. Ne kadar? = How much?)
Great place for touring Istanbul: Metro, mosques, ferries, shopping district etc. all within 10-20 min walk.
Perfect for a cat-friendly solo traveller who wants a lived in home and a vibrant neighbourhood.

Great stay and great host
Well worth the price paid
Fantastic location
Super clean also!
Esin was super helpful and kind

Evin konumu harikaydı merkezi yerlere çok yakın. Esin mesajlara hemen dönüş yaptı herhangi bir ihtiyacım olduğunda kendisiyle rahatça iletşime geçebildim. Dost canlısı bir ev sahibiydi bundan sonraki seyahetlerimde kesinlikle tercih edeceğim bir ev.

I felt right at home at Esin's place. I wanted to explore the European side of Istanbul while working, and the location was ideal. Bus stop was a 5 minute walk away. There is also a small store right next to the building that is open late so that was very convenient. Esin made me coffee and ordered lunch for us when I checked in, and I was able to rest after a long journey. Was grateful to Esin for handling all the laundry, as I got clean clothes the next day. The internet was good, and Seto the cat was lovely and friendly. The room is quaint but is all you need. The lounge room was spacious and had nice lighting, and it was filled with very artsy decor. It's a lived in home and is perfect if you are looking for that feeling for a home. Would love to stay again at Esin's next time I visit.

description: Discover your modern home in Istanbul's vibrant Cihangir! Perfect for long stays, this stylish apartment comfortably fits 2 guests. It features a unique brick wall, a dedicated workspace with fast WiFi, and a modern glass-walled bathroom. Located just a short walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, it's the ideal base for digital nomads and explorers. Enjoy the privacy of your own space in the heart of the city.

reviews.text:
Great location near Taksim and the airport shuttle, just one small street away from Istiklal, yet quiet and calm. Nice view of a Greek Orthodox church, and a police car is often parked nearby, which adds a sense of safety.
Very budget-friendly price for a compact, minimalist room. Everything matches the photos, and check-in is simple and contactless. Overall a good option for a short stay if you plan to walk a lot around Istanbul.
Please note: heating is via air conditioner and the room can feel a bit cold on the first night while it warms up. The bathroom has a floor-level shower, so the bathroom area can get wet. The apartment is a bit worn in some places. The door uses a code lock and is secure from the outside, but there is no additional internal latch.
Great value for money with excellent location.

I booked this accommodation because the photos appeared appealing, but it did not meet expectations. Before writing this review, I informed the host about all issues mentioned, but received no response.
Upon entering, I noticed very high humidity, visible through large water stains on the ceiling. The sofa was visibly dirty, and all towels as well as the bedding, duvet and pillows had stains. Overall, the living area appeared clearly unhygienic. Additionally, a power outlet was hanging loosely from the wall, which is a safety concern.
The bathroom was in even worse condition: the toilet had stains and traces of feces, and the sink, faucet and all holders were not properly fixed. The entire sanitary area appeared neglected and unhygienic.
The so-called “reception” was consistently dark and unstaffed.
Overall, the stay was very unpleasant due to the clearly insufficient cleanliness and hygiene. Apart from the central location, there were no positive aspects.

Had a wonderful stay at this place, looked exactly like the photos and the description. Everything was clean and well organized. In a great location and an excellent view.
The hosts are very helpful and responsive.

Excellent location right in the center of Istiklal Street, Istanbul. The host has thoughtfully provided everything you could possibly need inside the house. Very comfortable and convenient, absolutely worth it !

Great flat in area with lots going on. All in one room - kitchen area - bathroom - sleeping and sofa - but fine if on own or with someone you know very very well. Good layout and felt uncluttered and a nice place to hang out
The host was helpful
Near metro and not too far from the bus stop that comes from the airports
Lots of shops and food places nearby
Lift was working

description:
Enjoy a pleasant stay in your spacious and comfortable room in the heart of Istanbul, just a 2-minute walk from Istiklal Avenue. The calm atmosphere of Süslü Saksı Street and the energy of Taksim meet here.

Our room is ideal for both business trips and touristic stays with its private entrance, two separate comfortable beds, clean and modern design.

description:
Comfortable accommodation for 8 people awaits you in our 3-storey, detached apartment, just a few minutes' walk from Taksim Square, one of Istanbul's most vibrant spots! You can be comfortable all year round with spacious living spaces on each floor, a living room with a fireplace and air conditioning in all rooms.

An ideal, spacious and comfortable meeting point for families and groups of friends in the heart of the city. A perfect choice to explore historical and touristic places and feel the energy of Istanbul!

reviews.text:
Great stay! The apartment was very clean and the location was amazing — just a 2-minute walk to Taksim with only a short uphill (about 20 seconds). All rooms had A/C, the living room was spacious with a smart TV and good Wi-Fi. The kitchen had everything we needed, and the mattresses were super comfortable.
One note: the double bed on the top floor is made of two single mattresses pushed together, but it wasn’t a big issue. Even the sofas were comfy enough to sleep on.
The hosts were very responsive and helpful anything we asked for, they provided quickly. Supermarket is right next door.
Would definitely stay here again!

I stayed at Yunus’s place for 19 nights with my family (7 people).
The good:
* Very close to Taksim.
* The street felt safe.
* Plenty of space in the home.
* Yunus and his colleagues were always available, helpful, and responsive. We asked for a few items, such as a pot and vacuum cleaner, and they provided them.
* Several grocery stores are right on the street, making shopping very easy.
The things to consider:
* The street is quite steep.
* One bedroom is on the third floor and doesn’t have a door.
* There are no photos of the stairs inside the home, which could be difficult for older guests.
* The house was clean overall, but some of the appliances and sheets could have been cleaner.
Overall, we had a good stay, and Yunus and his team were helpful throughout our visit.

I had a fantastic stay at Yunus’s place! The space was spotless, well-maintained, and exactly as pictured. Yunus was an incredible host—very responsive and went out of his way to ensure I had a comfortable stay. The location was perfect and made my trip so much easier. I highly recommend this listing to anyone looking for a stress-free stay!

Konakladığım yer gerçekten beklentimin çok üzerinde çıktı. Ev dubleks yapıda ve 3 odasıyla son derece geniş, ferah ve aileler için bile fazlasıyla yeterli bir konfora sahip. Everything was good. The hosts were very nice. I just have to add one thing: the house has 2 floors of stairs and there are no photos of it.

description: I am a psychologist and I like to travel. It is a great pleasure for me to host you in Istanbul, which has hosted many civilizations of the world. You can reach the metro, train, bus and airport shuttles and many historical places, squares, museums and cafes in 10-15 minutes on foot. A wonderful experience awaits you in this clean and newly decorated historic building.

reviews.text: I stayed in this apartment with my daughter. It was very surprising when we walked in because it was more than we expected and more than the pictures shown. I would recommend anyone to stay here because I will come back again and again this is a very Beautiful apartment to stay in and I give you a five star review and I truly want to send the Host for everything they did for us and again, we will be coming back again and again many many thanks..

Check-in and check-out were very smooth. The apartment is clean, comfortable, and ideal for two people. It’s conveniently located near local restaurants and not far from Taksim. Please note that the area is hilly, which may be challenging if you’re not used to walking.”

We had a great stay at this apartment in Beyoğlu. The place was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the location is very close to Taksim with easy access to restaurants, cafés, and public transport. The apartment was quiet and suitable for a relaxing stay.
The only minor points to note are that there is some uphill and downhill walking with stairs before reaching the main street, and the street itself is narrow for car access. This may be slightly inconvenient for guests with luggage or those relying on taxis. Other than that, everything was excellent, and we would recommend this place.

I had an amazing stay at Berna’s place in Istanbul! The apartment was clean, cozy, and had everything I needed. The location near Taksim was perfect for exploring the city, with restaurants and shops just steps away. Berna and her team were incredibly responsive every time I had a question, which made the stay even more comfortable. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul 😍

Nice and clean place, both room are attached with eachother, 2nd room is within the first room. location is perfect, local shops, pharmacy, mosque , Taksim square ,bus stops everything is on walking distance so excellent location. I will recommend this place good value for money. although over all flat is bit small but good enough for a couple with one or 2 kids. balcony was good to sit and have coffee..

description: Our centrally located flat in Kadikoy offers an incredible opportunity with its prime location near all public transport. You'll enjoy comfort in this stylishly decorated home, equipped with fiber internet, air conditioning, and essential household goods. Just steps away from the vibrant Kadikoy life, the quiet, street-facing apartment is designed for your convenience. Unlike many old buildings you'll stay in a new building with an elevator, ensuring modern comfort and convenience for your stay.

reviews.text:
This is hands down the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in!
The apartment has everything you could possibly need for a comfortable stay. The hosts have thought of every little detail, from essentials like shampoo, cotton swabs, and bottled water to a fully equipped kitchen with all the necessary cookware. It was also great to have cleaning supplies, a washing machine, and even laundry detergent provided.
The location is perfect: very close to the metro, ferries, and airport shuttle buses. There are plenty of local shops and a market nearby, and a large supermarket is just a short walk away.
The host is incredibly helpful, responsive, and pleasant to communicate with. On top of that, the Wi-Fi is fast and reliable, and the self check-in process was very smooth and convenient. Highly recommend!

- The location is central and safe
- The building is new and it has elevator
- the host is very responsive and he checked in with us after 1 day to ensure we have no concerns
- in terms of the noise level, the apartment has a dynamic street view and it could be nois during the day. It quiets down at night time so it doesn’t bother my sleep at all
- the kitchen has sufficient utensils to prepare light meals
- it is very comfortable for up to 2 guests

Well equipped home - kitchen and bathroom have everything you need. Kitchen supplies (spices, oil) made it easy to prepare meals in the flat on a short stay. Clean and spacious - definitely enough space for two guests. Very near public transport. Plenty of cafes, bars, places to eat nearby. Very useful welcome sheet written by host with local recommendations. Also the building has a lift.

Bahat was very responsive whenever we have reached out, he recommended nice places for breakfast and made the transportation recommendations that have helped us a lot.
The place was walkable to the bus station , to the ferry station and the metro as well.
The house was clean and exactly as described.
I would definitely stay there once again !

I had a comfortable stay at Bagar’s unit n Kadikoy. This was my 2nd visit to Kadikoy & Bahat’s location was central, walkable to the ferry & metro.

The fact that this is in a relatively new building with elevator is another plus.

description: Located in the heart of Cihangir, Cihangir Modern Suite, our modern and fully equipped 1+1 suites are ideal for short and long-term stays. It is within walking distance to Taksim and close to public transportation. It offers a kitchen, bathroom, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, secure entry system and daily cleaning service. reviews.text:
The apartment where we stayed was spacious and had a lot of sunlight. The neighbourhood is lovely and felt safe, and we especially appreciated the very good water pressure in the shower. Communication with the host and staff was excellent, they were very welcoming and very helpful throughout our stay.

Overall, we still had a great stay and would recommend to everyone.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! Mr. Sinan was very helpful and a true gentleman, making my experience even better. The staff were hospitable, and the place was clean and comfortable. description: Stay in the heart of Galata with insane Bosphorus views, your own private jacuzzi terrace, and major vibes. This stylish 4BR loft is in a 19th-century building just 2 mins from Galata Tower. Sleeps 10, perfect for friends. Designer interiors, fast Wi-Fi, big smart TV, plants, AC, and a rooftop to chill hard. Live your Istanbul dream right here.

reviews.text:
The apartment is perfectly located! The terrace view is absolutely stunning. We didn’t even need to look for rooftop cafés.
The rooms are very clean, comfortable, and cozy. Snacks were provided upon arrival, which was a very nice touch. Communication with the host was great — all questions were answered quickly.
There is one important safety note. We are not lowering our rating because of this, but it could have seriously affected our stay. The staircase to the second floor is very steep and narrow, with no handrails. Unfortunately, I slipped and fell on the third day and got badly bruised. The yellow bathtub/sofa near the stairs made the situation more dangerous. For guest safety, we strongly recommend installing at least one handrail and moving it farther from the stairs. Also, the light in the small room was not working.
We would gladly return again — the view alone is worth it! Thank you for your hospitality.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The location was great, walkable to a nearby grocery store, Lily Cafe where we had a delicious meal, and the Galata tower! The place was spacious for our family of 7, and our favorite view by far was the upstairs loft that included the living room, kitchen and outdoor patio. The view from there is just incredible! We also appreciate how the host was so flexible with our check-in, hospitality with snacks and drinks, and helpful with our questions. Definitely recommend for groups or families that appreciate space and their own bedrooms!

We had an amazing stay in Istanbul! ☺️✨🇹🇷
Hamza was such a kind and attentive host – always quick to reply and genuinely helpful, thank you again for that.
The apartment was exactly what we needed: clean, comfortable and with a fantastic location. The absolute highlight was definitely the whirlpool with its one-of-a-kind view – such a special experience that made our trip unforgettable. Watching the sunset from there was magical! Everything worked smoothly from check-in to check-out and we felt well taken care of the entire time.
We’ll definitely be back for our next weekend trip to Istanbul. Highly recommend both the apartment and the excellent service!

We had a very enjoyable stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul overall. The location was absolutely excellent — close to everything we wanted to see and explore, with easy access to restaurants, shops, and attractions. One of the highlights of the apartment was definitely the incredible view from the 5th-floor balcony/patio, especially in the evenings. It really added something special to our trip.
Communication with the hosts was top notch from beginning to end. We had an issue with the hot water on our first night, but after contacting the host, he arrived within about 30 minutes and fixed the problem quickly, which we really appreciated. The hosts also arranged private transportation to and from the Istanbul airport, and both transfers were prompt, efficient, and stress-free.
There were a few areas that could use improvement. The patio furniture is quite worn and could definitely use an upgrade, as the seating area was somewhat uncomfortable. The sheets were somewhat poor quality.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Galata. Its view of the Bhosphorus River was expansive and mesmerizing day and night. The location was perfect for our family of four. It was just steps from the Galata tower and five minutes walk to Istiklal street, the Galata bridge (and its ferries) and similarly to the tram line which could take us to all the historical sites in Sultanahmet. It is on a quiet street just a block away from the tourists, so it was quiet and peaceful and felt like a local neighborhood. Two supermarkets a block away kept us stocked with everything we needed. The apartment itself had more than enough space for the four of us and could have accommodated several more. The kitchen had all the basics for easy meals (we cooked breakfast daily). AC was just enough during a very hot week, but could have been stronger. Note that the apartment is only reached via four flights of stairs (as clearly advertised)— we earned our views. We would absolutely return!
