reviews.text: It was a wonderful stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent and close to everything we needed. The host was friendly, helpful, and quick to respond to all our questions. We truly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for comfort and tranquility. Thank you for your great hospitality, and we hope to return again in the future.

Beautiful sea view and new building (important for earthquake safety) in a great location! The host was responsive and the apartment clean. The only downside is that the apartment is very basic - there's no decoration and basic amenities were missing (e.g. no toilet paper, water, laundry detergent etc). Pillows could have been more comfortable.

Overall, the stay was okay, but the host’s communication and follow-through were disappointing. Right after I booked, the host said there was an issue with the original property and moved me to a different unit, claiming it had the same view and included a complimentary airport transfer. I confirmed with support that this was allowed and accepted it, expecting to be moved back to the original booking within a few days. The substitute unit was larger and had a good view, but it was not remodeled and only one bathroom had hot water. After check-in, the host never followed up about moving us. Once we had unpacked, we did not want the inconvenience of relocating, so we stayed there for the rest of the trip. At the end of the stay, I contacted the host about the promised airport transfer, but even five days after checkout, I still received no response.

It was a great stay, very clean and organized. I am satisfied with the view we had the most, it’s very nice at night exceptionally. Bertan was very responsive and communicative. I would definitely recommend to stay in there if looking for a beautiful view with clean accommodation and a calm neighborhood. The WiFi is not very reliable but very nice stay overall.

reviews.text:
Elvan's apartment is located in residential alley but very close to the main road. There is everything you can possibly need from small markets, cafes, local restaurants and even barbershops. The area is not touristy at all, but just about 10-12 minutes walk from very touristy Taksim. I returned home around midnight and never felt any kind of safety concerns. If you are bringing in a large / heavy suitcase, just bring the taxi directly to the apartment to avoid the short hilly stretch.
The apartment itself is very clean with a spacious guest bedroom and common area, well equipped kitchen, clean bathroom and a big outside patio. The bed was very comfortable and I slept well.
The best part was obviously the host herself. Elvan provided with very accurate details on how to reach the apartment. I arrived two hours earlier than I had originally hoped for and she showed up in less than 30 minutes from her work to let me in. She makes one feel very welcome and comfortable and she means it when she says "this is your home now". I felt as if I was visiting a friend. As a local, she is quite knowledgeable about Istanbul and it's daily life. She advised me to avoid Taksim area one day due to police barricade and interrupted metro service.
Bonus: Elvan's adorable cat Ponyo! She is friendly but low key. She'll hang out with you if you want but won't bother you otherwise.
Overall, I had a great stay at Elvan's apartment and I will definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a place in non touristy area with some local life.

Bed was comfy, shower, patio and kitchen were nice and clean! Elvan is such a cutie and was so helpful and always answered our questions and gave us great recommendations and tips for Istanbul! She told us how to take metro to a trip to the Black Sea, which was a highlight! We loved staying in a part of the city were mostly locals live, so we had an insight in their daily life. The place is located near Taksim Square, we could walk up the hill (which was exhausting at times, because of the heat) and there were supermarkets on every corner, which was very practical! We would totally come back and I´m very glad we met Elvan and Murat!

Elvan is super friendly and helpful. She helped me before arriving İstanbul with all information and when I arrived she checked in for my by herself instead of leaving a key like most Airbnb does which is really sweet. You can really feel the warm of the host.
The apartment is really clean, and well decorated, since Elvan is living there herself ,you can find everything you need for a stay. There were kitchen utensils, fresh towels and a very cosy living room. While I was leaving, I didn’t have time to get food so she gave me some homemade food which was really delicious.
Last but not least, the location is amazing, it’s around 5min walk to Taksim square and there are supermarkets and cafes downstairs. Definitely recommend it !

The apartment is as described and as pictured. It is comfortable and clean. The location is great, but beware there are some serious hills to climb. I did not meet Elvan, but she always responded quickly to my texts. Her friend Burcu greeted me at the apartment and was very helpful to me with local advice. I highly recommend this place.

Simple but clean and supremely comfortable. Elvan's a wonderful host. No street parking but there's a pay otopark a block away. The neighborhood cats can be loud at night with the windows open but I suppose that's part of the ambiance.

description: Enjoy a peaceful island stay surrounded by nature in the relaxing atmosphere of Büyükada. Featuring a shared pool, garden area, and comfortable living spaces, this home is perfect for both short getaways and longer stays. Conveniently located near restaurants, seaside walking paths, and the ferry port. Experience the calm and charm of authentic island life away from the crowds of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
I wouldn't recommend this place. It is not as described and certainly it is not luxurious. Lots of things missing in the kitchen and the entire house and it is certainly not worth the price they are charging for it. Some of the basic things missing include: no iron, no ironing board, no toilet paper, not enough cups (only four for the entire house!), not enough cooking utensils, no extra towels (they offer access to a swimming pool), no clothes airer, no dishwasher powder, no washing powder, no refuse bins, no oil, no sugar. The list can go on for a while. I will stop here.
The place is finished to a poor standard (windows not closing properly, broken door handle) , the pool is shared with other three villas run by Büyükada Apart as well as the patio. So when you're outside on the patio having your dinner, people from the other villas walk through the patio to gain access to their properties or go to the swimming pool.
One of the mattresses had springs poking out of it and when we turned it around we found urine stains on it. Yuck! We obviously did not use it after that sight!
Overall, not a pleasant experience. They charge premium prices for a poor-quality product and service.

Clean house 15 minutes walk, about 5minutes up hill, from city center. House has a shared pool, across from a small playground, and is on the main hiking/biking pathway up the hill to the monastery, orphanage, and Luna Park restaurant. The hosts carried our bags, showed us around the house, and provided bath towels and hand soap. The spacious and clean house was very comfortable and great for a group of people. Be sure to get the white taxi number for home pickup; taxi and bus stand is behind the clock tower.

The place was great but the photos said there were a pool but it was not working.
Also the location u see on the map it’s not as same as the house location but they have transfer for ur baggages only for check in!
Beautiful and comfortable villa. Everything was clean, and the host was very helpful. Highly recommended!

Ev sahibine çok teşekkür ederiz. Çok güzel bir yılbaşı geçirdik. Fırın istemiştik o da mevcuttu. Ev tertemizdi. Fotoğraftaki ile aynıydı. Oldukça geniş ve ferahtı. Biz gelmeden önce ev ısıtılmıştı. Her şey düşünülmüştü. Havlular tertemizdi ve banyo terlikleri bile vardı.

description:
Registration Details
34-1931

reviews.text:
Pros:
Location is prime, best location possible, 5 mins walking distance to istiklal street and also safe, there are multiple grocery shops, liquor shop and a cafe very nearby.
Host communication is very good, very humble. Overall a good experience, house also is of decent size, Also host provided a taxi at decent price to airport, appreciate that
Cons:
Bed didnt seem clean, it was itching quite a lot. Also spray in toilet wasnt working, should provide disposable slippers, the slippers provided were very dirty, kitchen didnt have proper cutlery, and even though they were provided the problem is it wasnt what we needed and it was given later in day as the staff wouldnt be present till afternoon at times, staff should be present most of them time to server customers need as customers are short on time always.

We stayed at Ilhan’s place for 4 nights and felt satisfied and comfortable. The location is not near to the old town but there are lots of public transport to access to many attractions. The place is clean and tidy. It equips proper and well-functioning facilities such as TV, AC, fridge, stovetop, washing machine, hot shower, etc. The host, Ilhan is friendly, helpful, responsive and solution-oriented. He also offered us complimentary water and bread. Ilhan’s place also offers free luggage storage at the reception. His receptionist Mr. Rusel is also very nice and helpful. Though there is no view from the apartment, we would recommend Ilhan’s place :)

I am so happy for finding this place on airbnb. The host was always replying to me every time I texted him with clear information. The apartment was very clean and nice, with perfect ac a, a television, a bathroom with all the services needed and omg the bed was just the best I ever had! So comfortable. Also the location is great, a few minutes walking from the bus stop that takes you everywhere, but the Taksim area and Galata are very close and I was always going there by walking. If I come back to Istanbul I will definitely book here again! Thank you for everything.

We stayed at ilhan’s place for 3 days, it was a pleasant experience! The apartment is located in a calm neighbourhood, with a small shop and bakery conveniently located next to the building
The main highlight of this apartment is indeed; The heated floor ! It was so comfortable, that we felt it was no need for the heater (they have one too !) .
Communication was great too, we
The place was clean, equipped with sufficient amount of kitchen equipment and tablewares.
In the bathroom, warm shower is always available (for us two plus a baby) , and again; heated floor in the bathroom is a MAJOR THING ! Thank you !!! 😀😀😀👍🏻👍🏻
Communication was good ! We spoke to ilhan 3 days pre-depatures, and he arranged for us to meet resul and kept our luggage in his office before checkin time.
I recommend heartily for couple staying with baby to stay , as they provide baby crib and baby chair, and their hospitality goes beyond extra mile.
Tesserkuler ilhan and resul !

I stayed there with my family. Ilhan was very responsive, easy to communicate with, he helped us with an early check in as we requested.
The location is great as it is close to Istklial street and Taksim square.( Just one tip, avoid going to the apartment from the downhill side as it is difficult to manage with heavy luggage).
The apartment was clean and contained all amenities as described and looked like the photos.
Overall, nice stay that I would recommend to anyone visiting Istanbul.

description: Amazing studio apartment is in the historical center of Istanbul only 5-7 minutes away Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace. The studio apartment 30 square meters is on the 3 floor

reviews.text:
Everything was excellent. Absolutely.
1. The apartment is located near Sultanahmet square, 200-300 meters from Blue Mosque and Aya Sofia. There are two tram ("metro") stations within walking distance (Sultanahmet and Cemberlitas) from which you can go almost anywhere in Istanbul.
It was a little bit tricky to find it for the first time but then we had no problem. Hikmet met us nearby and explained how to get to Sultanahmet from the house.
2. The apartment was clean and cosy. Hikmet gave us even bigger apartment than we booked ([URL REDACTED] There was all the staff needed there: an iron, hairdryer, microwave and fridge. The bedroom, the kitchen, linens - everything was impeccably clean.
3. There is wi-fi in the house.
4. Hikmet gave us an excellent present: we had huge and incredibly delicious breakfast for free!
I can highly recommend this host and his apartments in Istanbul for all people interested in good accommodation for a reasonable price.

The place was exactly as described and shown on pictures. The building has 3 floors and on the basement there is Hikmet's tourist office, so at all times, someone (him, his son, or his nephew Firat) is there to help you. Although it is airbnb house, they had the room cleaned every day and sheets and towels changed every two days. All of them are very friendly and polite although we mostly talked with Firat who seemed to speak better English. We arrived early (11:00) and we left our luggage at the office. We returned at 18:00 and they had our luggage in our flat on the 3rd floor. Cold water and a basket of cold fruit were on the table for us complementary. During our stay we met them several times and they offered us tea, coffee and fruit. The location is very close to everything in the historical center, although there is a 150 meters of road with high incline, but old Istanbul was known to be built around 7 hills! If we go again in Istanbul we will stay there for sure. Hikmet can also organize pick-up from airport with reasonable price (at 40 euros for 2 persons, which is cheaper than taxi or other carriers).

We first stayed at Hikmet's accommodation in 2015 and returned. The apartments are up a couple of flights to stairs about 5-10 mins walk to the Blue Mosque and all the amazing sights. Right across the small street is a beautiful view of Sokullu Mehmed Pasa Mosque which for some reason doesn't have the early morning muezzin call so a good sleep. On the top floor is a terrace where we had breakfast and tea while the sun set. Beautiful. The apartment itself has everything you could need - full kitchen, good bed (large bedroom), excellent shower and is nice and light and very clean. A big reason for our return is the wonderful host Hikmet who has lost none of his joy or enthusiasm for hosting. Istanbul is a wonderful city and this accomodation is just far enough away for a bit of respite but close enough for full immersion! We'll be back again...

The apartment was exactly as described. Hikmet was very friendly and went so far as to leave some fruit and a bottle of water in the fridge and serve us a welcome breakfast on our second morning. Everything was clean and worked well. The Air conditioning was a special mercy in mid July. it was only a five minute walk to the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Highly recommended.

Hikmet's listing is a studio apartment on top of their family-owned tourism agency. The family is lovely and Hikmet was very responsive. Because we didn't speak Turkish, I texted him on WhatsApp after landing and he called me right away and offered to speak with the taxi driver directly to explain where to go in Turkish. The listed photo makes the place look place slightly nicer than it actually is, but we just needed somewhere on the cheaper end in the historical center. The one thing we were not happy about were stains and hairs on the sheet under the top sheet (I saw them because I broke the bed apart to look for an earring). Overall an ok stay considering centric location.

description: Our studio apartment is a 5-minute walk from Taksim Square.

reviews.text:
Serhat has been a wonderful host. We arrived early and requested to check in before the given time and Serhat was extremely accommodating to us. The room was lovely and just as seen in the photos but the balcony was the real gem; the views were spectacular! The AC was working perfectly (which was a must!) and the bathroom came with little soaps.
The location is great if you want to stay around the Taksim area; it’s close to multiple bus stops and the metro so getting around is fairly easy, and we loved being closer to more local spots nearby. Be aware that there are steep hills by the location but these hills are all over Istanbul and you cannot avoid them regardless of where you stay - we got used to the walk home by the second day. I think there is also a specific alternative route you can take from Taksim Square so you don’t have to walk uphill on your way home.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend Serhat as a magnificent host - thank you!

One of the best places to stay!
Everything was perfect — price, location, room, and especially the host. The apartment is very clean and fully equipped, you will find everything you need for a comfortable stay.
The location is amazing — close to everything. There are 24/7 shops nearby, cozy cafés and restaurants with delicious food. It’s also within walking distance to Dolmabahçe Palace, Galata Tower and many other beautiful places.
Highly recommended! I would definitely stay here again.

Only one good thing that the location is good. But you could also get 1000's of hotels and airbnb's in the same or better location for more or less the same price.
First of all we travelled with the infant so this place is extremely not suitable for that.
The bathroom had a very bad smell coming out of it every 15 mins and it felt really bad.
There is lot of incorrect information in the AD regarding the amenities: No Bed linens, one bath towel, no extra pilows or blanket, no iron and most importantly NO STOVE.
There were stains on the bed sheet and it was worn out. There was no place to cook or warm the food. Even though the host offered us the gas stove but it was too inconvenient.
To finish it on a positive note, the host is a very nice person and tries to help you in every way.

I was supposed to stay in the accommodation for 6 days but unfortunately had to leave after the first night.
There was a dirty fridge ( with a fly, hair, and filthy shelves), dirty cupboards with water stains inside, and cutlery/utensils nearly nonexistent. In one of the cupboards and nothing to cook on. The safety deposit box had no instruction on how to set it up with a new code, but….the host offered to pop in the next day to show how to do it (wasting my time on holiday). The sealing was full of water stains, and the balcony was covered with a nasty plastic thingy. The host was very rude after the Airbnb contacted him about the state of the property - I was sent a message: ‘What do you want me to do? it was rainy for the last free days.’ No ‘sorry’ or apologising for the whole situation. Thanks to Airbnb, and their fantastic customer service, I moved the next day to a lovely property. Avoid this accommodation at all costs.

The place was as described, it had all we needed, it was good value for the money. And Serhat was very helpful and promptly responded to our queries.
Location: It wasn’t as easy for us to get into the city, hard to find taxis and takes very long time to get into the city centre due to the constant heavy traffic.

description:
This studio apartment is located at the heart of city’s coolest neighbourhood ''Moda'' walking distance to Kalamış Coast, shops, restaurants, famous bars, markets and all transportation. Just a 5 minutes walk to the famous “Boğa Heykeli”.

- Designed with taste, this apartment will be ideal for anyone who is seeking comfort, a “home like” atmosphere, accessibility to major tourist attractions.

-Self check-in is also available using the password.

-The sofa is prepared for the third person.

reviews.text:
Good host! <<
Location is good for the price.
Hardest thing for me was that I didn’t realize how firm the mattress would be, so I had a hard time sleeping. (*Mind you - Firm mattresses are super common in Turkey)
There was clear communication and any questions I had were answered with relative ease.
Definitely grateful for the elevator, even if it is very small.
Unfortunately, we could often smell the cigarette smoke from the people in the room next to ours from within our own room.
I also didn’t realize from the photos that the bedroom wouldn’t have a door but instead is open to the entire space. This may or may not be an issue for some 🤷🏻‍♀️
The washing machine was tricky to use due to the placement of it inside the cabinet, we had to squeeze our hand up the side in order to pour in the detergent. (Hard to explain...but it was an interesting challenge!), still, thankful that there was a washing machine available in the room.
The stove was of great use and there’s some minimal dish ware, & the full-size fridge 👍🏻
They also take your trash for you (just leave it outside your door).
Overall it’s good for the price. But I wouldn’t say it was the “best” experience. Mostly due to my personal preferences I’m not sure if I’d stay again, but I would still recommend.

I was extremely glad I searched AirBNB for accommodation in Kadiköy. The value for money is hard to beat. The apartment is fully self contained and having a washing machine and a full sized fridge and kitchen to prepare meals in for an extended stay was ideal.
Having a lift in the building after a long day of exploring was wonderful.
The location is great: so close to the seafront, public transport, awesome restaurants, bars and shopping but just out of the main city bustle so it was nice and quiet in the evening. It’s a 10 minute easy walk to the ferries for a scenic ride to just about anywhere.
Being close to the stadium was a treat too - I was able to feel part of the amazing atmosphere of game day, a true local experience I would have missed in a more touristy location.
Convenience stores and great takeaways literally across the street and a wonderful view from my apartment.
Deniz and İclal were so friendly and helpful with their information. I was most pleased with my stay.

The host is very responsive and helpful. The location is very central, just a few minutes walk to Kadikoy. The apartment is as described, very roomy and clean. Highly recommend, if you are looking for a central, clean and roomy apartment (suitable for 2 adults)

Was ok for the price. The location was good, but it didnt look like the photos at all. Photos are for sure few years old, not that clean and many things were falling apart. Also the one employee at the entrance was rude. Can recommend for a short stay but would not recommend for too long. Very noisey apartment, you can hear every foot step from neighbours

dairenin konumu, rahatlığı, temizliği ve geri kalan her şey çok güzeldi. (meraklısı için, WIFI çok hızlıydı.) Deniz bey gerçekten çok yardımcı bir ev sahibi, sorularımızı anında yanıtladı ve iletişimde hiç problem yaşamadık - kendisi bize bölgeyle ilgili önerilerde bile bulundu. kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğim, herkese de gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebilirim. işini severek yapan insan kendini her yerde belli ediyor.. tekrardan çok teşekkür ederiz!

description:
Relax in our recently refurbished, modern rooms decorated in earth-tones. Hard-wood floors, natural light shining through floor-to-ceiling windows offering remarkable views, and fine linens and plush pillows, all enrich the comfort you feel at our apartments.

Choose among rooms that offer stunning views of the Sea of Marmara and across to Asia, or our rooms with the picturesque views of the old city and Sultanahmet district.

reviews.text: Great location! 6 minute walk from Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Great value for what you pay for and the room looked like the photos. Only suggestion is it needs more pillows, otherwise bed is comfortable and place was clean upon arrival. Would recommend!
As described. Great view to enjoy, and a 10-25min walk to a lot of Istanbul’s famous sites and tons of restaurants. The self check in and out was super easy, and the apt was modern and clean.

Saw lots of positive reviews, stayed here. The place was not clean, happens sometimes, that’s okay — they said the rusty bathroom was “rustic”, like it was a stylistic choice, just buy a new one before guests come in. This stated by her employee, who wanted a fist bump afterwards.
Grey hairs everywhere, dirty chairs, dirty shower, filthy hairdryer, really dirty — the cleaner didn’t do a good, if any, job on this.
I got a rash and multiple bites from the bed — it was not ideal, I had to leave and find a new place. Host stated they gave a clean unit. I think there was a language barrier with the meaning of the word clean.

I loved this listing because of the sea view. It delivered on that end. It’s a small but spacious unit and the washroom heater works well. The mini fridge was useful. Zeynep was a wonderful host. I couldn’t fly back in time because Dubai International Airport was closed and Zeynep was accommodating and considerate in her responses to me. I think the price is reasonable. The house help left the place spotless. The location is really good because everything you need like groceries, food & clothes are near and available + the Sultanahmet old city location means many tourist hotspots are right by. Great place.

Very clean and comfortable room with a great view overlooking the Bosphorus. Zeynep was very helpful and responded straight away to any questions or issues we had. 10/10 location about 10 minute walk from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia with loads of great restaurants in the area.

description:
2+1 shared (with me) furnished apartment with a backyard in Fatih.
Few minutes by walk to the Çapa tram, Topkapı metrobüs station.

It takes few stations to the touristic places such as Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar etc. Every Tuesday there's an amazing bazaar nearby where you can buy fresh vegetables, fruits and other stuff.

Note: There are extra bed sheets, blanket, and pillow.
Note 2: I work from 10:00 to 18:00 weekdays at office.

reviews.text:
Amid is an amazing host, he has been very supportive since the very beginning he gave us very useful advices about the restaurants pazars and malls and places to visit in Istanbul he made our stay very pleasant and comfortable he was very friendly.
The apartment is located in a very good neighborhood we felt safe all the time and it was close to transportations.
I will surely go back to visit again.

Flat has everything to stay for long or short time (kitchen, everything to cook, wash machine, bathroom, living room, fast wifi and so on). We lived in separated bedroom, which you can lock. Flat has terrace with barbecue place. Local area has a lot of shops(with all stuff for house and to cook food), coffee shops, fast food. In 15 min by walk you can get tram station to get center of city . Local area is quiet. Householder is wonderful and kind young man, who will help you, you can trust him. I recommend this place to stay.

Amid’s place is located in a peaceful, non-touristy neighbourhood that we absolutely loved. There’s a lot of food places, shops, supermarkets and tram/bus stations nearby, convenient for short and long stays alike. Amid is such a nice, friendly, and kind host who gives us a lot of help, tips, flexibility and private space!! We really really enjoyed our stay and won’t hesitate to recommend his place to anyone travelling to Istanbul ☺️
Attentive and considerate host, clean place. Very good communication. Recommended!

Place is really wonderful, there are a lot of restourants, cafes and supermarkets around it. Transportation is also good, you can go anywhere with public transport in a short time. Amid is also friendly and helpful. He answered my every question about istanbul (such as, best places to go, where can I find good meal). This trip surpassed my expectations.

description:
The Apartment is in Karaköy, Beyoglu which is located very city center and also you can reach easily metro, tram and bus stations. Very close to Taksim, Galata Tower and main cafes, restaurants and pubs.

This a building which is operated by our company and we do have 10 studio apartment within same building. We have uploaded our studio to the gallery.

According to availability on the arrival date; one of the studio apartments will be assigned to our valuable guests :)

reviews.text:
Overall the apartment is really nice and clean, exactly as shown in the photos. The location is comfortable as it is close to most of the main attractions by feet. Otherwise there are taxis and public transportation nearby. The communication with the hosts is excellent, they are super friendly and helpful and give a lot of tips and advice for your stay. During the day the location is pretty loud and crowdy but I don't think that's a problem because we weren't much in the room during the day. I really appreciate that they did an early check in for us as we arrived earlier than the check in time.
Only thing I didn't like is that we run out of hot water both days we stayed.

Perfect for a few days city break - clean, comfortable, near to public transport and with a helpful reception downstairs. Convenient to leave luggage for after check out too.
The apartment was close to the metro and minutes from restaurants/bars etc which was great. The only thing to note is the building is slightly down a backstreet - during the day the alleys are filled with DIY shops but at night these are all shut so it could feel a little uncomfortable walking alone late at night. We had no problems though!
Overall good value and very happy with our stay here

Absolutely loved our stay here! The space was spotless, everything as described and super well located to walk places or get the bus/metro. Hosts were very responsive, proactively offered cleaning and fresh towels and let us leave luggage for a bit after check-out. All the amenities you need worked perfectly- good air conditioning, good WiFi, hot water etc. The area felt safe to walk home at night. Great place, would recommend!

I enjoyed my stay. I was very comfortable as the building is secure. It was walking distance to Galata Tower and Istiklal which was great. The place is comfortable and an appropriate size for one person or a couple. The water was hot for showers and the bed was comfortable. Communication with host was quick and clear.
The wifi was not great, so I used my data a lot. There is no sound-proofing, so expect to hear noise from the street and other units. It was not terribly disruptive for me, but something to note for light sleepers.
I found it was not possible to get Uber from the location because the map seemed to be inaccurate in the app, so I just walked out to the street and got taxis which was quite easy as it is a busy street. The private transportation was not reliable as it was late, both from the airport and to the airport which is very bad, but this is not the host's fault as it was another company booked. Overall, I would stay at this place again, and be prepared with mobile data and another form of transportation.

A great "home from home" place in a quiet tucked away location.
Easy to find with excellent directions and communication from the hosts, this private apart-hotel is just a couple streets away from the centre of Karakoy. Set in a quiet street away from the noise of local traffic, the apartment block was clean and tidy and with lift access to all floors.
The apartment was large and bright and spacious with comfortable bed and clean linen, with a couple of easy chairs and a small dining table with chairs. The ideal base for doing your own thing in the city with the chance to come back for a cheeky siesta before heading out to Galata or Taksim or the Golden Horn areas.
The hosts were friendly, responsive, and usually on site if you needed anything, but also I enjoyed the independence of coming and going with my own key access.
I look forward to returning to the same place later in the year!

description: Stay in the heart of Çukurcuma, one of Istanbul's most charming and historic neighborhoods, just a short walk from Galata, Cihangir, Karaköy, and İstiklal Street. Hosted by Homie Suites, this stylish one-bedroom apartment offers seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and everything you need for a comfortable stay. Surrounded by antique shops, art galleries, cafés, and local restaurants, you'll experience one of Istanbul's most authentic neighborhoods.

reviews.text:
The place is cosy, good for one person or a couple. Had all the basic amenities you would want. The bed is very comfy. Tv works perfectly, had a Netflix session. It looks exactly as pictured close to Tophane tram station so easy to get about. Good selection of cafes and one of most recommended hammams on the same road a few feet away.
Cons - when we entered the apartment there were ants on the kitchen counter, however the communication with the host was good and they sorted it out promptly. There is a slight smell in the bathroom but I reckon that’s because of old pipes rather than a lack of cleanliness.

Great apartment in a fabulous area! The apartment was exactly as it looked in the photos, safe and secure building, comfy bed, modern, good WiFi, good lift, great communication by Homie. I had an issue with WiFi and Tunç was quick to respond and we worked out it was my VPN that was actually blocked due to government restrictions, so Tunç suggested another option, which worked and I got back online. Highly recommend, plus fabulous cafes (Serenity), restaurants and bars (Solera bar), enjoy!

Exactly as the pics describe. Ideal for a single person as quite tiny. Neat and clean and very easy to check in etc. The elevator is a plus if you have a large suitcase. Great location. I will stay here again.

This is a wonderful apartment on the top floor of a modern apartment building - perfect for a solo traveler or a couple. The kitchen was well stocked, and the balcony was a nice edition with some great views of Istanbul. The neighborhood is incredibly central to exploring the area - right above a great coffee shop and lots of shopping nearby. The elevator in the building takes you up most of the way, only one flight of stairs to climb. Check in was seamless with a door code and lockbox. Super quiet place - right off the main streets so you do not hear much. The sunsets are wonderful to see from this apartment. The hosts are incredibly helpful and go above and beyond to help, in addition to their flexibility of check-out time when possible.

We booked this Airbnb last minute due to unexpected schedule changes, but this place is so much better than the ones we stayed at for five days just beforehand. The Airbnb is professionally run which means the facilities are all well maintained and the room is super clean (which unfortunately is not something you can take for granted these days). In addition, the location of the building is close to everything but at night extremely QUIET. In a loud city like Istanbul, this is really priceless for light sleepers. Our host was always responsive, even though we checked in on a Sunday. One last thing is the ceiling might be low for those who are tall since the apartment is on the top floor, so watch out your heads :) Other than this highly recommended.

description:
Hello and welcome 🌿 Our studio apartment is located on the ground floor and has a small private garden. Discounts apply for monthly stays.

1️⃣ Please specify the correct number of guests at the time of booking. No additional guests are allowed after confirmation. There is paid indoor parking for the car

2️⃣ All guests are required to provide photos of their ID or passport for registration. ‼️

3️⃣ ⛔️ There may be occasional noise due to renovations in the building next door.

reviews.text: I arrived late in the day so the lobby was locked but there were detailed instructions with pictures on how to enter and get to my room. As others have said for the price it’s an excellent place to rent from. The finer details of the room didn’t quite match my expectations through the pictures posted but it was clean, quiet and PRIME location to get to the ferry. Maybe 5-10 min walk to a huge selection of restaurants and food venders. I was trying to translate and follow instructions on the free washer and dryer when Beyazit noticed me, immediately came down the stairs, had me put my clothes in, loaded the free soap and pushed all the buttons for me. I had limited interacts with him but always friendly and respectful. Super host indeed

The place is clean and looks as advertised. Good wifi (>70Mbps download and upload most of the time). It's near the ferries, subway, there are a lot of shops nearby. My only issues were:
1) English communication (Beyazıt was very helpful, it just takes a little bit of effort to understand each other)
2) The room is a little bit cold in the winter but it was -2C° when I arrived which is uncommon for Istanbul. I did not ask Beyazıt whether he has an electric heater.
I recommend this place.
Thank you for hosting me!

Great location. Everything was clean, host gave me exactly what i needed.
Very comfortable and quiet room.

Great for the value. Comfortable bed and small kitchenette for basics.
Small private garden space for ourdoor, shaded sitting. Centrally located, but protected from sound because it’s in the back of the building — quiet for sleeping.
Beyazit and Murat quickly
communicated and we’re a pleasure to work with.
We stayed here because it’s
such a short walk to Moda and to public transit.

It's a nice place in a great location for a short stay. It's part of a hotel but they have converted the basement room into a studio. The room size is decent and small kitchen for a quick coffee or breakfast, bathroom is small and could fix the tiles in the shower cubical but it's functional. There is someone at reception most part of the day so it's secure and you can ask them if you need any help etc. Beyazit is super friendly and responsive so our communication was perfect. I would recommend this place to other solo or a couple travellers.

description: Two Bedroom Suite of Pera Residence are glorious and have an area of 150 sqm.Tastefully decorated with modern furniture,Pera Residence 's Two Bedroom Suites have a marvellous design, relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful week here and spent six nights in this apartment. It is very, very pleasant. The apartment is modern, clean, highly comfortable, and quiet—even though it's located in a trendy, bustling area with plenty of restaurants and 24-hour activity. You don't hear a thing inside the apartment. The location is excellent, with easy access to everything, major sights, and public transportation. The kitchen doesn't have many amenities. In fact, it has almost no utensils at all if you plan on cooking. However, you have great access to restaurants and markets in the area. If you want a quick snack or prefer to eat out, it’s very easily accessible. I will definitely stay there again when I return to Istanbul

We had a wonderful time. The apartment is huge and in a really great location. I loved the big living room, bedrooms and bathrooms and tons of storage space. I wish the owner posted more photos because the current pictures don’t do it justice.
My only complaint was that the floors were a bit dirty when we arrived and dishes were still in the dishwasher. The owner didn’t initially provide any of the essentials (paper towels, soup, toilet paper) but was very responsive when we requested it. I would also add a bit more decorations to make the place feel a bit more homey.
We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend this to our friends!

Great location, close to Takseem street nice bars and restaurant in the neighborhood, you dont have to worry about noise or anything bedrooms are sounds proof
Clean place , staff extremely helpful

This place was extremely well located, the place was much bigger than it looked in the picture, everything was very clean and while the street was pretty noisy till two or 3 o’clock in the morning, do it back into the bedroom and close the door I didn’t hear a thing. We slept very well. I would say again.

With every place there are good and bad things.
We'll start with the good. The service was great and very accommodating. They answered messages promptly and and issue that came up, they were there in no time to fix it. The location was incredible. Access to many attractions and restaurants. They place is big and easily accessible with an elevator.
However there were issues. The location. As centralized as it is, you need to be prepared for the amount of noise that surrounds the apartment. High volume traffic - cars and tourist. Loud bars that stay open until 4:00 am. If you plan is to party in the city, then it's no issue. The second bedroom's bed isn't as big as you would think. It might be a full size, but that would be generous. Pillows were bad. Not much as far as cooking utensils
Also, the place has seen better days. Things were breaking left and right. We stopped advising the reception about those issues. To be clear, the ones we did tell reception, they fixed immediately.

description: Private Studio Apartment, private bathroom & private entrance in the heart of the Sultanahmet Old City, just a min walk to all major historical sights Blue Sultanahmet Mosque & Hagia Sophia & Topkapı Palace & Underground Cistern and Sultanahmet Center.The apt is equipped with: *air-conditioning *free wifi*Flat Screen TV with satellite channels *orthopedic mattresses *mini size kitchen *dining table/chairs *iron & ironing board *hair dryer *towels, sheets and blankets, free cleaning.Sea Wiew ap.

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant stay overall and especially appreciated Yilmaz's hospitality. He gave us a warm welcome upon arrival and arranged our airport pickup, which made getting settled easy. The location of the apartment is excellent, with many of the city's major attractions within walking distance.
We stayed for a week. There are a few areas where some updates could make the guest experience even better, particularly for longer stays. Additional towel sets would have been helpful, and refreshing some of the older towels could go a long way. We also found that the bed could benefit from a fitted sheet, as the top sheet tended to come loose during the night.
The shower took a little patience to find the right balance between hot and cold water, and the water pressure was somewhat limited, but these were not major issue for us.
Overall, Yilmaz was a responsive and welcoming host, and the location is hard to beat. We enjoyed our time and would like to thank Yilmaz for his hospitality.

Yilmaz was THE BEST host I could have asked for. I stayed for 5 weeks. The apartment was pristine - beautiful, quiet and in such a nice area. The locals are so friendly, there’s a grocery store 2 steps away and a beautiful, quaint little restaurant all within the same block. It’s about an 8 minute walk to Sultan Ahmet & Hagia Sophia, and very central to the beautiful Old City of Istanbul. Walking distance to Grand Bazaar as well. Favorite place in the area was Topkapi Palace & Basilica Cistern.
The home was absolutely stunning, especially the mural. Everything was so clean, with a laundry machine for your use which was so helpful, and the TV has all major streaming services. Wifi was immaculate and super fast which was phenomenal as I was working remotely throughout my stay.
The hosts were always checking in, super communicative, very kind and sent me all the great places in the area, which was so helpful. I’ll definitely be staying here again once I’m back in Istanbul. 20/10 ☺️

Nice unit in a great location, just a 10-minute walk to the historic center of Istanbul. Comfortable bed and plenty of hot water, and the space heater was very welcome on chilly January mornings. Yilmaz was friendly and helpful, arranged my airport transfer, and brought me some delicious baklava during my stay. Thank you for helping me with my suitcase! Many restaurants and shops in the area, and of course plenty of friendly cats.
Wonderful, warm hosts and an excellent apartment in a great location. Walking distance to major historical and cultural sites. Air conditioning and a comfy bed, what more could you want!

The host is the most hospitable host that I ever met. He helped to arrange for airport transfer and welcomed us at the door during our check in. He came to the property to help us with the hot water in the bathroom even at 11pm. When we were leaving Istanbul, he accompanied us during our checkout and offered us some local Turkish delight as souvenirs.
In addition, he provided some great recommendations during our stay at Istanbul. We had dinner at his restaurant, which is affordable and delicious.
The property is quiet at night and within walking distance to Sultanahmet, which is very convenient to go to anywhere in Istanbul.
Overall, we had a great two night stay at the property.

description: The room is located in a calm street right in the historic centre of Istanbul, close to many attractions: from museums to msonuments to delicious food and the Istanbul nightlife. Only 50 meters away from The Taksim Square, making it easier to access public transport, pharmacies, hospitals, restaurants and shops. Our instagram: @daphneperataksim

reviews.text:
I was in Istanbul for the Champions League final - so accommodation was at a premium and I had heard stories of people paying over the top and even having reservations cancelled so the accommodation could be rented at a higher price.
Kahraman's accommodation and everything about the process was the opposite of the difficulties others were facing.
Location - could hardly have been better - only a very short walk to Taksim Square - so right in the heart of things
Communication and support - Kahraman was extremely helpful and responsive to any question I asked and Christine was also very helpful and approachable
Cleanliness - indeed the room was very clean
Description - Yes the room was a small double - but that was made clear in the description and pictures - It was exactly has I had expected.
Price - I thought that the price was very reasonable - given the booking was at the time so many extra people were visiting and accommodation was at a premium.
Overall - excellent

Sakura Apart: The location of the apartment is on a very steep slope which makes it almost impossible to walk down without slipping.The entire building is extremely small.The room we received was on the lower floor, basically a basement.I genuinely felt like I was staying inside a cave,and the host kept insisting that it wasn’t a basement.We were forced to leave and book another hotel. On top of that,there was constant noise in the bedroom coming from some device,and it was leaking water onto the floor, I canceled this room.Lotus Room: Very small — you can’t open a suitcase or place your luggage anywhere. Even the bathroom is too tight.I canceled this room too.Magnolia Apart: Slightly better, but we found an insect on the wall and the bathroom was small.we kept it.After leaving honest reviews about these issues, the host left a review on my profile with inaccurate and unfair claims, trying to portray me in a negative way, which is completely false. I have evidence and photos.

We liked our stay very much - the apartment was located central, that we could easily reach a lot by foot. The metro is close as well, which is perfect for getting to know the big city.
While the room itself is small (as described and expected), it feels very comfortable & has everything we needed.
The communication was always easy and really friendly, online as well as in person - (thank you a lot for making us feel welcome!)
I can really recommend staying there, it was just perfect for our city trip. If we‘ll visit Istanbul again, we‘ll be staying there for sure☀️

We enjoyed our stay at Kahraman’s place! The location was great and Comfort helped us a lot. She was so responsive. The room was clean and comfortable. We definitely recommend this place for your stay in Istanbul.

Absolutely loved the place. The room was perfect for 2 people, everything was clean & tidy. The location is perfect as it was away from all the noise and a 3 mins walk from Taksim square. Kahraman was an excellent host and he replied to my messages right away. 10/10 would recommend!

description:
Tucked away in a peaceful corner of Büyükada, this seaside villa offers a special island stay with a private pier, lush garden, seawater pool, and beautiful sea views.

Enjoy summer days swimming from the pier or relaxing by the pool. In winter, unwind by the sea-view fireplace for a cozy island escape.

Guests stay on the spacious ground floor with a private entrance and full access to the outdoor areas. The host lives upstairs with three friendly Jack Russell dogs.

reviews.text: This was one of the most memorable places my family has ever stayed at. The yard was absolutely gorgeous in the front and in the back of the house. The shrubs and the trees throughout had botanical gardens feel to them (the pictures on-line do not do them justice, they are much nicer in person). The house (we rented the bottom portion of the house only) had designer architecture accents (beautiful arches, heavy wood doors, rich antiques, expensive furniture) in the lobby, kitchen, and living area. There were two bathrooms and showers, and three bedrooms in the downstairs portion that we rented and our family of 6 was very comfortable. Kitchen was stuffed with absolutely everything you need for cooking. Everything inside and outside was spotlessly clean. Ozlem and her two, sweet, well behaved puppies were upstairs and kindly helped us with directions, taxis, ordering food, and more! We didn’t speak Turkish and without Ozlem’s help would not have had the same experience on the island as we did. We took water taxis there and back which was a very convenient option because we traveled from US and had lots of bags.

We loved our stay at here . The location was perfect and just what we were hoping for .
The outside space is beautiful ( and exactly as photographed ) with lots of shade and sunshine and places to relax . We spent most of our time relaxing outside .
The inside is large and well furnished for your stay .
Ozlem was an extremely helpful & friendly host

Such a beautiful place. The pictures are not nearly a representation of how beautiful the place is. Simply wonderful. Ozlem is a great host. She made our stay as comfortable and fun as possible….
The house is so close to Istanbul yet the place takes you far away to a tropical place…
This is going to be our favorite summer destination.

Hiç Ada tatili yapmamıştım ve bu ev bana çok huzur verdi. Öncelikle ev sahibi Özlem şahane bir insan . Dost canlısı, neşeli ,enerjisi evine yansımış ayrıca dünya tatlısı 3 tane köpeği var ve çok şekerler. Ev düzenli temiz ihtiyaç olan her şey var . Arkadaşlarım ve ben ayrı odalarımızda çok rahat ettik . Ev geniş ve ferah. Özlem konum için market için yemek için her konuda destek oldu ve anında dönüş yaptı. Ben çok huzurlu bir hafta geçirdim öyle ki seneye de gitmek için can atıyorum. Bizimle ev sahibi gibi değil de dostumuz gibi ilgilendi. . Kendisine çok ama çok teşekkür ediyoruz 🙏🙏🙏

Ozlem was an amazing host! She greeted us warmly at the gate with her three lovely dogs, which was such a nice welcome. She even arranged a sea taxi for us to get on and off the island, which made everything so easy.
The villa itself is absolutely beautiful—honestly, it looks even better than the pictures! This is the kind of place worth planning a trip for. Ozlem was incredibly helpful throughout our stay, even assisting us with ordering food for me and my family on multiple occasions.
A wonderful place with a fantastic host. Highly recommended!

description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.

reviews.text:
Hasret’s place is great value for money for temporary budget travellers visiting Istanbul.
The location is very convenient and is in a short distance to the main road where you can find the bus stops that will take you to take Taksim or to the European tourist side to Sultanahmet for 7.25 TRY one-way
Also, it is only 20min walk to the Havaist Taksim bus stop which will take you directly to SAW airport for 50 TRY one-way
Local side road convenient shops where you can buy essentials and 5L water for 11 TRY
The location is behind one road away from the Himalayan Nepali restaurant which I highly recommend for a local price
Another 20min walk will take you through Istiklal street, towards very good cafes and restaurants and to the Galata tower.
Highly recommend the Lebanese restaurant for Turkish breakfast 199 TRYOUT- Arada Cafe - You will not regret this!!!
The buildings off the main road are still underdeveloped, look rundown and the roadside is a little dirty but don’t let that deter you from this great location.
Checkin with Hasret via WhatsApp was great, was responsive and provided detailed entrance instructions.
The room is on the second floor, no lift and you’ll walk up a carpet stairwell.
The room itself is all you need for your basic stay. Photos are just as described but the carpet, furniture would benefit from an upgrade + new fresh paint + new bathroom sealant
- clothes rack with hangars
- a single pair of floor slippers
- comfortable double bed
- small wall hung TV
- small kitchenette with utensils for eating / NOT cooking
- kettle
- small coffee table area with 2 yellow sofa chairs
- bathroom has a toilet, shower closet, small wash basin with mirror, wall mounted shower gel dispenser, floor bin, toilet paper, fresh towels are provided
- wifi had good connectivity but low bandwidth (could not support 2 devices on zoom)
The room had a big ceiling fan which was great to cool the room, can leave on all night to sleep (it is a strong fan / the light shade moves a little but it will not fall off)
There is a door that leads to a small balcony where there is a small sofa and there is another door which is a window, great for allowing cool air to come in.
Stayed for 3 hot summer nights, the outside can get a little noisy with the neighbours and the odd car/motorcycle but still managed to get good sleep with the door closed
Overall, great location for budget travel, to do all your tourism in a day, walk in and head to sleep, wake up and repeat
If you have high western living standards, avoid this place and pay a higher nightly rate
This place is most suited for very short term budget travellers
Nice room in a noisy and dirty neighborhood. We chose it for the kitchen, but there wasn't a stove top. We had problems with hot water, but the host came to fix it

The place has no fridge and the host asked to return him the portable kitchen stove because "place is not suitable for cooking" even though there are pans and pots clearly for that purpose. 2 of 3 light sources in the apartment are broken and the one left is not enough. Tablecloth is dirty with stains and the table itself even more so. Bathroom sink only had cold water in it and host didn't even try to fix the problem. The boiler is in the main room and produces loud noises making it hard to sleep.

bedsheets were smelly and stingy. washroom was not usable as all the taps and shower were leaking. We had to close the main valve of the water otherwise water was flowing all over the floor. However, the host was very cooperative and responded quickly for addressing the internet connectivity problem, but the appartment was not good.

Literally in one of the best spots ever. you’re in walking distance to most things, plus the metro station and there’s a bus stop right around the corner on the main road. The most annoying part is that there were some noise disturbances in the morning from neighbors, but other than that, it’s a great value room!

description:
At AB Residences Istanbul, culture, art, and history are not nearby they are on your doorstep.

This 2-bedroom Istanbul apartment steps from the Bosphorus, Taksim Square, and Karaköy, this is Istanbul at its most vivid and authentic. Galata Tower, Istanbul Modern, Pera Museum, and the antique shops of Çukurcuma are all within a short stroll.

The preferred address for film productions, corporate stays, and discerning travellers who seek the exceptional. This is where Istanbul reveals itself.

reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at AB residence The place was spotless and exactly as described , clean, cozy, and well-maintained. The location is perfect, situated in a lovely area with plenty of shops and just a short walk to Taksim Street. But what truly made the experience exceptional was the host’s hospitality and communication. They were incredibly responsive, helpful, and went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable.
Highly recommended

From start to finish, this stay was perfect. Check-in was effortless, communication was clear and responsive, and everything was exactly as described (if not better). The location is outstanding, close to everything, yet still comfortable and relaxing. The apartment itself is beautiful and very cozy, with thoughtful touches like heated floors.
We had such a great time in Istanbul, and this place played a big part in that. I definitely would love to stay here again, highly recommend.

First of all, big shout out to Tolga. He is as what every other reviewers’ positive reviews said about him, extremely friendly, accommodating, helpful, responsive, and proactive. We arrived in Istanbul late and it was past 10 pm by the time we got to the apartment, and Tolga was there to greet us and check us in, despite that he already had another prior social engagement for the night (I think a big sports event was happening).
And all throughout our stay, Tolga was there for our every needs. This was my first time visiting Istanbul and Tolga is the perfect Airbnb host you will want and need to have to help you navigate your experience.
And the apartment itself is very nicely decorated, looks just like the pictures. The showers are very nice, exactly what you would need to come back to live after a long day being out exploring the wonders of Istanbul. One more thing to note is that the mattress and pillows are very comfortable, all very important parts to a great trip! 👍👍

This place was unique for a couple of reasons the 1st the elevator and second majestic windows floor to ceiling all over and they came with true BLACK OUT shades in the bedroom.
I loved my giant real king bed .... nightstand on both sides with electricity and a LAMP !!!
so wonderful to have a lamp next to my bed
Then the million dollar shower ! Real pressure and really hot and the 4 jets on the wall blew me away. The rain head worked at the same time and it was delightful.
So many towels and it felt more like a hotel than Airbnb. The location is perfect 10 minutes to taksim sq and the apartment was surprisingly quiet.
The staff responded to my requests instantly and I really love this place so much.

This is literally one of the best apartment i have ever been too, The interior is amazing every detail was beautiful the showers the kitchen the rooms literally everything.
The host was really nice and helpful and he replies so fast and We were welcomed really warmly.
The checkin and checkout were really smooth and quick.
The location is great it’s literally near to every single place
the safety was 10/10
They also have a 24/7 valet parking
If I visited Istanbul again this is will be my first option to stay for sure!
Thank you tolga for everything:)

description: Masif House is small authentic charming white wooden house in Istanbul run by a Turkish family. we will be happy to see you in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Masif House was a great pick for my son and me. It was comfortable, clean and located about 850m away from the Blue Mosque area, offering good connectivity to all the main attractions. The room has a an AC and radiator which you can use according to the weather. There is a supermarket about a stone’s throw away and we could buy water and other essentials. It is located in a quiet neighbourhood and was super peaceful. The sister hotel, Saruhan is where you check in and out and they offer a buffet breakfast for 7 EUR - great spread of food with a view of the Bosphorus Strait. Overall, I am glad I picked Masif House over other hotels.

We had a really great stay in Istanbul and truly enjoyed our time here. The accommodation was cozy, clean, and in a perfect location close to all the main sights in Sultanahmet, while still being in a quiet enough area to relax after a busy day in the city.
What made the experience especially nice was the staff and hosts. Everyone was very kind, welcoming, and always willing to help us with recommendations, directions, transport, or anything else we needed during our stay. Communication was smooth and friendly from the very beginning.
The rooftop breakfast at the sister hotel was also a lovely experience with a beautiful atmosphere and view.
Overall, this place gave us a very authentic and comfortable Istanbul experience. We would definitely stay here again and happily recommend it to other travelers visiting the city.

We had a lovely week staying at Masif House. The location is great and although the walls are thin and other guests can sometimes be heard, the neighbourhood is very quiet and we slept very well. The room was comfortable and clean. Good communication and friendly people. The option of breakfast on the rooftop of the sister hotel was welcome. We only did this once but loved the beautiful views from the terrace.

Great and cozy place to stay! The room looks exactly like the photos as described. It’s available for leaving luggage there before check-in and after check-out if needed.
PS: Since there is a subway line passing nearby, there may be some noise. But as we were out most of the day, it doesn’t bother us much.

The room is very large and clean compared with most of hotel rooms in Istanbul. The room is 100% the same as the pictures shown on Airbnb,and can definitely be ranked top 1% in whole Istanbul. I would strongly recommend this place, because the environment has surpassed my expectation. The owner of this apartment, Elif, is an elegant, helpful, polite, and extraordinarily beautiful lady. I really enjoy my staying here.

description:
Last thing you should worry about is your comfort on a vacation. You will have all the privileges that you need and more while you are exploring the breathtaking city Istanbul in this elite residence located right in the heart of Taksim/Istanbul.
In this stylish residence, besides every luxury comfort, and there is a Paid PARKING lot under the building...
We also provide a folding BIKE for those who want to experience the city to its fullest...

reviews.text:
First I want to say Handan is an amazing lady! She is an excellent host who caters every need of her guests. She is very humble and professional.
Second, her apartment is beautiful and as described in listing. The huge windows and beautiful balcony! Two bathroom are very handy with family of kids. Room and hall are spacious. Kitchen is fully equipped with cooking utensils. The apartment is neat, clean and cosy. Very near to Taksim square and Kabatas metro station. It is walkable and straight road. Was very easy for me to move around with old age parents and kids in stroller.
Highly recommend this place! Will definitely cone back again

We had an amazing time at Handan's place. It's exactly as shown in the photos: spacious, clean and secure. It's close to Taksim yet far away from the noise and chaos. The trams and ferries are easily accessible and the neighborhood has a nice vibe.
Handan was super helpful, quick to respond to questions and just an overall amazing host. Would definitely recommend her place for short and long term stays.

This apartment truly felt like home! It was incredibly clean, warm, and very spacious, with two bathrooms and plenty of room to feel comfortable. The kitchen had everything we needed, and the apartment was thoughtfully equipped with every detail in mind. There are two extendable sofas, all very comfortable, and the bed was also extremely cozy. It’s clear that a lot of effort has been put into ensuring guest comfort.
Everything in the apartment is modern, beautifully designed, and of great taste. The building is new.and even has a bus station right across the street, which is very convenient. Plus, the partial sea view makes the stay even nicer!
The host was exceptional—immediately responsive and very considerate of guests' needs. She even accommodated our early checkout request, which helped us a lot.
The location is great, close to Taksim Square. Just a small note—the apartment is on a slight hill, but it’s walkable.
overall an amazing stay, I would happily return.

We had an unforgettable stay in the heart of Istanbul
Hanada is phenomenal host alway responding for all inquiries and really helpful. Everything was easy from check in till check out.
The apartment was really clean and neat cosy and comfortable, bright, all appliances are there, and easy to use. Bathrooms are really clean ,modern, big and functional.
As for the location, it is really close to everything . Minutes walking to Taksim square and Istiklal street , where you find Lots of restaurants, supermarkets, cafes, shopping and lots of entertainment.
The area is extremely safe if you are visting alone or if you are with your family.
We would always go back and stay at Hanada’s apartment every time we visit Istanbul .

The apartment was exactly like the photos and was clean and comfortable. We were able to plan our journeys to avoid climbing hills and the trams were excellent. There was a significant issue with entertainment for us. We enjoy a quiet evening watching a film after being out exploring each day. On our first evening we were unable to access Netflix on either TV. Unfortunately this wasn't resolved until the fourth day of stay. The air conditioning wasn't always sufficient in the living room and the lights also could have been brighter.

description:
A well designed flat with everything you need for you to feel like this is your home away from home. You get a cozy and newly refurbished flat with a nice kitchen, a great living room, a comfortable bedroom and a modern bathroom. Place is beautiful decorated with your comford in mind during your stay.

The flat is located in Central Istanbul, quarter of Beşiktaş where life never stops. Apartment is close to everywhere such as many types of transportation, restaurants, Pubs and shops.

reviews.text:
A great apartment in a great location. The apartment is very spacious, well equipped and modern finishes. The apartment is located on a lively walking only street with tons of restaurants, bars, and coffee shops. However inside the apartment was quite and comfortable inside.
Bonus: The apartment has "room service" available from the restaurant downstairs

By far one of the best Airbnbs we’ve stayed in. It was nicely decorated with a lot of space. Aside from slight issue with AC in the bedroom, stay was very comfortable.
Location was also very good, right in the middle of Beşiktaş’ restaurant and bars. Also, great access to ferry and main roads. Getting cabs can provide problems though.
I would highly recommend this for a group of friends or couples that want to experience the nightlife. I would not recommend for older people or families due to the fact that it’s on the 4th floor and you can still hear music from bars at night.
Overall, we couldn’t be more happy with our stay. Thank you to Bartu and Sarp for the hospitality!
We had a great stay in Istanbul! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Everything went smoothly and we would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
The place is very beautiful, very clean and tidy, and the location is excellent, but the apartment is located on the fourth floor and there is no elevator

Wonderful apartment located in the heart of all that Besiktas has to offer. The apartment is cosy and well equipped, bed is very comfortable. The neighbourhood is noisy on the weekends so I would bring earplugs if you are a light sleeper.

description:
Hi everyone!
Firstly My flat is 3-5 minutes walking to Ciragan Palace and Besiktas Square.
But still very quiet apartment.
You can even wake up to sounds of birds some mornings.
Because this apartment is next to Yildiz Park

reviews.text: Cem is very friendly and understanding person, he waited patiently for me to arrive at 19:30 and welcomed me. The location is close to the night life in Ortakoy.
mesajlara çabuk dönen, ilgili bir ev sahibi. evin konumu gayet iyi, sessiz ve merkezi. tavsiye edilir

The location is one of the best in Istanbul and it is right in the central. Although the flat is located on a hill, the location is still one of the best in Istanbul. Cem is very hospital when it comes to serving his guests. I will recommend this place.

i really recommend the hostel , its in a very calm place, at the same time not far of the center , so u can live the night life 10 mins about your home and then go to home rest & relax in quiet environment, The host was so kind he met me at the time so I didnt need to wait , & welcomed as he knows me before that. I recommend

Cem is the best host ever. Friendly, helpful and communicative.
The place is very good. You can find everything you need. And not hard to reach there.

description:
The widest angle Bosphorus view of İstanbul! Enjoy the watching cruise ships, historical&iconic builts all in the one view in this luxury Duplex. 4X Best view awarded.
Walking distance to Galataport, Oldtown and many restaurants. It is far from the noise, central, located elite part of the city.
2 minutes to the tram, taxi station and ferries. Just near by the seaside and 7 minutes walking distance to Taksim. It’s one of the largest houses in Cihangir.
Restaurants and markets serving 24/7 around

reviews.text:
This flat has a view of the Bosphorus strait that would be hard to beat. The view is worth every penny.
The flat is two stories. Level 1 has both bedrooms, and a full bathroom (shower only). Level 2 has a living area, kitchen, balcony, and a small bathroom with only a toilet and sink. Note that the ceiling slants in the bathroom and may make it uncomfortable to use for taller people.
The balcony has an amazing view of the strait, and the Asia-side of the city. You can spend hours watching the fishing boats, and cargo and cruise ships motor by.
There are about 40 stairs to navigate from the street to the flat. I believe if you let the host know your arrival and departure times, he will meet you at the flat and help with your luggage.
Near the tram, which can take you to the Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Spice Market, Taksim Square, and other Istanbul attractions.
Bring your walking shoes.
Also, the host was amazing.
We highly recommend this flat.

We've stayed at a lot of Airbnbs in İstanbul and I can safely say that this was THE best place out of all. Bedirhan is an amazing host who was super helpful and always present. He gave us a thorough walkthrough of the apartment when we came and even left us Baklava as a gift. The apartment was extremely clean and the pictures don't do it justice because the view and ambience is SO much better in reality.
The location is perfect and one could not ask for a better neighborhood to stay in. Everything is accessible and yet the area is still calm and not noisy at all. I enjoyed every second of our stay at Bedirhan's and would recommend it to everyone who's looking for a comfortable and memorable stay. Thank you Bedirhan for being a great and courteous host!

We chose this pet-friendly, larger accommodation for our family of 3 but then plans changed and only 2 of us stayed without our dog...It was pricey compared to other accommodations, but the view sold us! We were very comfortable in Bedirhan's home for our week-long stay in Istanbul. We were met by one of his colleagues who showed us how to get inside- and he even carried our suitcases up the steep spiral staircase! Bedirhan responded almost immediately anytime we reached out and he was a very gracious host. It was really nice to have a balcony to watch the boats travelling up and down the Bosphorous Straight, the views were really nice. He provided water and coffee and tea for us, which was nice. The kitchen is well-equipped with glasses, tea and coffee cups, utensils etc but make sure to bring spices if you intend to cook. Upon checkout, Bedirhan came to say goodbye and also to carry our suitcases down the stairs for us. He seemed to genuinely care about our comfort and happiness.

Apsolutly stuning view on Bospohorus ! Apartment was clean , rooms are spacious , you have all you need . Location is for those who know Istanbul perfect becouse you can walk to many city atraction ( food , markets , history …) , regarding that it is the one way narow street . Yoy have private parking in front of the building . Worth every penny !
Now about the host … Wow … Bedirhan should have badge super-super-host ! Always responsive , proactive , he waited us with the check in , and walks us out during check out at 6am . This is the definition how every host who is in this bussines should be ! He will do literary everything in his power to satisfy the guest needs .

The duplex was amazing, truly better than the pictures. Very clean and has candle cents everywhere which made it cozy.
The host send us details on check-in but insisted he be there to help us and made sure everything is good. We needed some stuff and he helped us with it, he always answered when we needed him no matter what time. He even helped arranged a taxi when we checked out and helped with the bags.
The duplex has an amazing view to the Besfor it is on the third floor. There are two bedrooms ( fresh bed sheets and towels) and a bathroom (with a washer and handsoup/ shampoo). One of the bedroom has a small balcony with a view to the Besfor. The upper level has a living room ( with tv and sound system) and a gorgeous view very breath taking, and a kitchen that is (fully equipped).
The only downside is it is on the third floor and to go to the Besfor you need to go down lots of steps (around 200 step) which is common in the area but very hard with kids. However, the host has a parking space if needed.
I will definitely recommend this place to family and friends.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. 1+0, new, flat entrance, quiet apartment, 5-minute walk to metro and ferry pier, bus stops. There are security cameras and fiber Wi-Fi at the entrances.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay. The room was small but cozy and clean. Wifi was good and I didnt have any problems doing video calls. Location is in a quiet street not far from the city center with lots of restaurants, cafes, and pharmacies. When I lost hot water in the bathroom IIker was able to send over a technician right away.

Ilker is very friendly and talkative, the place is well located and it's fair what you pay for it, there's no windows but on the back there's a door you can open to get air and it has fresh air ventilation from the room. The shower setting is a bit odd but nothing to be worried about, it was well designed to drain the water quicky
Good location near the central parts of Kadiköy. Ilker was always helpful and available if we needed anything.
İlker is a very hospitable and helpful host. The apartment is well-kept, has everything that is required for a short stay and it is in the very centre of Kadıköy.

Great location. Right in the middle of Kadikoy. Close to everything. Perfect stay if you want to stay for maximum 3 nights or something. I stayed here for a month and because there is no sunlight or window with a view outside there is no fresh air. If you’re gonna stay in Kadikoy just for a few drinks for a weekend then it’s a good idea. I don’t reccomend a long stay here

description:
Newly build flat in Pera, good for short and mid-term stays, for families and couples.
Location: minutes off main busy road, in authentic Turkish neighborhood.
300 m from restaurants
600 m from Galata Tower
700 m from Tünel and Atatürk Bridge
1 km from Galata bridge ( easy access to Sultanahmet & Grand Baazar)

Flat is recently built with designer hand-made wooden elements.

reviews.text: This is a beautiful one bedroom apartment flat; ideal for solo travellers or couples. It is positioned very close to Tunel, Asmalimescit and Galata area; yet since it is a 5-10 min walk to that district, at night you can have a good sleep away from noise and crowd. The flat is just as it is described in the pictures; even more beautiful.. The house was extremely clean and tidy; and the owners are doing a kind, friendly and professional job guiding you on how to check in; or on othet info that you should know.. and they are very fast to respond when you have a question. I will definitely stay here again in my next trip to Istanbul.

Clean, nicely laid out. Great shower. Kitchen equipment sparce. Coffee jug handle fell off and the glass jug exploded when we gently placed the lid back on. We reported it and were charged for a replacement. As Airbnb hosts ourselves, we would not have given the replacement charge to our guests, given what happened. Great location. Lots of street noise and cigarette smoke coming into the flat from the street.

Very comfortable apartment, clean, cozy, and fully equipped.
Great location (situated in a calm area within a lively neighborhood).
The only downside was that there were no linens for the sofa on the first night (even though we had specified that we needed them when we booked). As a result, the first night was not so pleasant.

The host was very helpful from the very start and throughout our stay kept providing us with some important information. The building and the apartment met all our expectations, even more. The place is very cosy, clean, nicely furnished and well-equipped. It's close to the Metro and bus lines. There are some shops and supermarkets near the apartment. The apartment is close, within walking distance, to some nice coffee shops and restaurants. Yet, the neighbourhood is quiet, friendly and safe. We do highly recommend it.

We had a great time in this apartment. It's close to good touristic places (Galata tower and bridge) and tramway/metro stations. A big street will provide everything needed, lot's of restaurants, bars, open late, ... Apartment was clean, with air conditionner and very handy.
Also, host was very reactive and always their to provide advices :)

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located apartment. Independent apartment in a quiet alley within walking distance to Kadıköy center, shopping center, all public transportation (Metrobus, Marmaray, Metro). The apartment has basic kitchen and food utensils, personal hygiene supplies, a washing machine and internet speed suitable for remote work.
