reviews.text: Great apartment: very cosy,clean and comfortable.Super fast wi fi connection.Amazing terrace.We felt like a home far from home.The location is very nice : quite and central.Many shops, restaurants near by .Nice walking distance to sea promenade.The host is great: very attentive and hospitable.We have everything you need in one place . Thank you very much for hosting us.

I had an wonderful stay! First I must say that Yahya is an excellent host and awesome guy. He is very helpful and communicative, he always checked and made sure I had everything I needed. He also made sure any little issues were taken care of. He goes above and beyond!
The apartment is also super nice. The balcony with it's nice view of the city, the rocking/swinging bench and the singing birds is very relaxing.
The apartment is well equipped and has everything you need for a great stay. The bathroom looks new and modern and well done with the hot water always working perfectly.
The location is also really great. It's just a short walk to get to cafes and shops in Kadiköy, and very conveniently, about a 10 minute walk to a Marmaray station which can connect you to the entire city of Istanbul.
If you're looking for a relaxing stay with access to explore the city, I recommend this place!

Bizim için en önemli iki şey olan evin konumu ve temizliği oldukça iyiydi. Evde ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz hemen hemen her şey mevcut, iletişim de çok iyiydi ve ekstra ihtiyaçlarımıza hemen destek oldular, tekrar teşekkürler. Evin terası gerçekten bu mevsimde akşamları vakit geçirmek harika. Yalnızca yatak/karyola iyileştirilmesini tavsiye edebilirim.

The host was very welcoming and easy to communicate. Everything you need for a short trip was accessible. Clean house, excellent location. Terrace was also beautiful to chill. 10/10 recommend this place

This is one of the best apartments we've ever rented. Excellent location (near YHT and Marmaray station, within walking distance to Kadikoy ferry berth), while in a quiet place where there is no fuss and noise. The apartment was perfectly clean and very well maintained. The apartment has absolutely everything for a comfortable life. Everything is thought out to the smallest detail! I would love to stay in this apartment for a longer time. Thank you to the owner for the love he has invested in this apartment.

description:
Apartment in a luxury site with a decorative pool, landscape view, security, family-friendly, spacious, built in accordance with earthquake regulations. Close to the hospitals area and Marmaray metro. There are social areas such as grocery stores, pharmacies, restaurants, cafes, and walking parks. Close to Mall of Istanbul and Arenapark outdoor shopping mall.
Although the check-in time is 3:00 pm, it can be moved to an earlier time if there is no other check-out on the same day.

reviews.text: It’s a wonderful apartment located in a really pleasant residential neighbourhood. The location was perfect, with stunning views of the condominium’s pools, indoor garden and the neighbourhood itself (which gets pretty nice sunsets) from the balcony, and all the amenities I could need nearby (two supermarkets, a pharmacy, a few restaurants, a cafe and a bookstore). The apartment itself was impeccably clean and furnished, with comfortable beds and plenty of space for ourselves (similarly priced flats in the area tend to be much smaller). The private underground parking is very convenient if you have a car. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a place to stay in West Istanbul.

I recently stayed at this place, and I loved it. The location was just perfect for me as I was visiting a friend who lives nearby. The apartment is situated in a quiet, gated, and safe neighborhood, and it's not too far away from both train and bus stations. Mr. Önder was very communicative and helpful throughout my stay. There are plenty of grocery stores and restaurants right in front of the apartment complex, which made things very convenient for me. On the day of my departure, I felt overwhelmed due to work, and unfortunately, I left some of my belongings at the apartment. However, Mr. Önder quickly contacted me and helped me retrieve my things, even bringing them to me. I truly appreciate his kindness and honesty, and I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay.
Excellent conditions, clean, gated neighborhood. Wonderful hosts, welcoming and helpful during the entire stay, if you need them!
Her şey yazıldığı gibiydi; güzel manzaralı, huzurlu, temiz ve ferah bir daire. Site yakınında tüm ihtiyaçlarımıza cevap verecek alanlar mevcuttu. İlgili bir ev sahibi, teşekkür ederim.
It was a great stay. Convenient location, several supermarkets within walking distance. Friendly and helpful host. Solved all additional issues.

description: My suites are in Sultanahmet, the most beautiful and most historical area of Istanbul. There are 5 or 10 minutes walking distance to historical places. Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, shops, markets, tram stations, boat and bus stops.Our suite is a room with a balcony. The kitchen is in the common area. Laundry and drying service is charged

reviews.text:
Cavit’s apartment is well located and close (5mins walk) to most restaurants and (10mins walk) to tourist spots like Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Bascillica, etc.
The apartment itself is a bit run down and we had found the bed dusty, unclean pillow covers and broken light switches and ceiling in few places.
On informing the host he arranged to clean the bed and provide new sheets and pillow covers.
Few things to note:
1) The apartment height is much lower than standard. Anyone above 6ft would find it difficult.
2) The apartment walls are not solid walls so you can hear the noises from lobby quite clearly and it did get noisy till 12pm on most nights.
3) The wifi is really slow and I struggled most time to get good speed or strong connection even.
4) Cavit and the reception team are responsive and do try to assist as much as they can.
5) The location is close to tram and well located in Old Istanbul.
Besides the wifi and slightly run down interiors this a good budget friendly option

My husband and I stayed here for 3 nights.

Good side:
- His place is well situated to some of the best restaurants we have found on Gmaps.
- Walking distance to major attractions like: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapi, and Grand Bazaar. Just be ready for the uphill and downhill terrain of the narrow streets.
- Receptionists are all helpful and friendly.
- Cavit is a very responsive person.
Downside:
- Toilet & mattress need a thorough cleaning.
- Better pillows
- The walls are thin so you can hear other guests outside (which is understandable because most of the infrastructures turned into a hotel/airbnb have small alleys).
- AC is a bit noisy
Overall, we would still recommend this place to our friends whenever they visit Istanbul. Thanks Cavit for hosting us.

This hotel is really a decent place if you want to stay close to the Marmara sea it's quiet, and has elevator and shared kitchen facility. It's located from a walking distance to most major attractions in old city. Plenty of restaurants and laundry service close by. Pleasant and helpful staff.
Had a lovely time! Easy to access, clean and comfortable. Great communication from the host and easy access to local historical sites and transit stations from the location.

Everything is alright. But we are hear some noises from the neighbors in the every morning. And smoke fumes from the downstairs…
Apartment is the same on photos.
The attractions are very closely .
Tram station is about 5-7 min for a walk
Sultanahmet sq. About 10-15min for a walk.
There are some restaurants near the flat.
Good place. Thank you, and I wish you all the best.

description: My suites are in Sultanahmet, the most beautiful and most historical area of Istanbul. There are 5 or 10 minutes walking distance to historical places. Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, shops, markets, tram stations, boat and bus stops.

reviews.text:
This place is all about location. it is 7 minutes down the hill from the main street with tram stop. All the major sites are within 20 minutes walk and lots of restaurants around yet it is quite at night. Also Erol in reception is super helpful and friendly, plus he speaks perfect English which is rare in Turkey.
The suite itself is on the third floor of Marmara suites which is accessible by a small lift. It consists of a bathroom, a living area and a bedroom. The rooms are smaller than what it looks like in the photos but the furniture match, perhaps a bit older but still good and comfortable. The kitchen, work area and laundry are shared and located in the basement. We did not use them bat they looked clean and tidy.

This area of Istanbul has been my go to for my past 3 visits. I was surprised to see that this place had an elevator. While it’s small 2 people max it’s way better than walking up 3 or 4 flights of stairs when you already walked all day up and down hills in Istanbul.
The room was clean, matched the photos and perfect for my Fiancée and I. The Staff was very good and responsive. Many good restaurants in the general area that I discovered in my past visits. Very close walk to the Tram (metro), the Grand Bazaar and of course Starbucks in case Turkish coffee isn’t your thing.
Normally from IST airport I take the Taxi at the taxi stand but some times in this area the driver will tell you he can’t go any further for whatever reason and you might have to walk a few minutes with your bags up or down hilly streets. However, this time I used the offered car service and it’s right to the door. It was worth the extra cost over the taxi.

I had the pleasure of staying in the apartment. The location of the apartment was great, as it was very close to all the major sights and attractions that Istanbul has to offer. The beds and bathroom were comfortable, and the description of the apartment was accurate.
The persona who greeted us was very polite and responsive to our needs, which made our stay our stay even more enjoyable.
However, there were a few issues that I would like to mention. Firstly, the water pressure in the apartment was quite weak, which made showering a bit of a challenge. Additionally, the shower faucet was quite low, which was not very convenient.
Moreover, the keys provided to us were identical to the keys of other apartments in the building, which was a critical security issue. Our key could open the door of another apartment of our frieds and vice versa. I believe this issue should be addressed and fixed as soon as possible.
Despite these issues, I still enjoyed my stay and would recommend it to others

Check-in was simple and quick.
The rooms were clean on arrival, but were not cleaned every two days as expected; the cleaner had fallen ill.
Neighbors were all quiet so we slept easily. Beds were comfortable.
All features and amenities were functioning and available.
We felt the apartment’s greatest appeal was the location.
Great location and easy check-in. Cleaning service was nice and host was very responsive. Good for the price.

description:
Why You'll Love It Here:

Vacation mode starts the moment you arrive! Enjoy a year-round pool, luxury spa, central air conditioning, and state-of-the-art gym.

Guests rave about the exceptionally comfortable beds, making every night restful.

Dine at the on-site restaurant, shop at Starcity Mall right across the street, or visit Mall of Istanbul just minutes away.

Skip the cramped hotel room and give your family the space, comfort, and upscale experience they deserve.

reviews.text:
Family stay of 18 nights.
2 bedroom apartment.
Third floor.
Clean, spacious, comfy, secured, family friendly, beautiful exactly as in pictures. This apartment has a fully equipped kitchen including microwave, dishwasher, smoothie blender, toaster .. etc.
Air conditioning is available and works properly but the only disadvantage is it is available only in the living room and master bedroom not in the 2nd bedroom unfortunately despite they told me it is available in all bedrooms. The host provided us a fan to solve this issue.
This apartment was prepared as a residents hotel. Plenty of towels, 4 bathrobes, sanitary tools (enough only for 1 week) and clean linens.
We enjoyed the big terrace.
Plenty of secured parking lots. We felt safe as there was a 24/7 concierge/reception in the building. Location is 40min from airport and downtown so you might need a car
The swimming pool was for extra charges. The host was responsive.
We would book it again and again !

I had a wonderful stay at Nadira’s place. She was very responsive and helpful throughout the booking and stay. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures. It was clean, spacious, and beautifully maintained.
The facilities and overall atmosphere were lovely, and the location was central and convenient for getting around. One small detail I especially appreciated was the consistent hot water in the shower. It may seem simple, but it made a big difference after long days out.
My family had a great experience in Istanbul, and it was always a joy to return to such a comfortable space at the end of the day. I would definitely recommend booking with Nadira to anyone visiting.

Wonderful Apartments – Comfort and Impeccable Cleanliness!
Our stay at these apartments was excellent. Spacious, bright, and spotlessly clean, they are perfect for a comfortable stay.
The apartments have two cozy bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom, and a spacious living room with a fully equipped kitchen. All necessary appliances and kitchenware, including double teapots for Turkish tea, are provided.
The beds are very comfortable, with quality mattresses, pillows, and blankets. Blackout curtains ensure restful sleep.
Check-in and check-out were smooth and contactless. The hosts were always available and helpful.
Highly recommended for a perfect stay in Turkey!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment!
The place is exceptionally clean, spacious and truly has everything you might need — from a garlic press in the kitchen to laundry detergent, shampoo, soap and even dishwasher tablets. It felt like a real home, where every little detail has been thoughtfully provided.
The area is very quiet and peaceful, and the large parking space is a big plus.
The hosts were incredibly polite and always available, explaining everything clearly.
We would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

The place was super clean and fully equipped to the finest details, super comfortable sleep and considering our purpose of visit it was a perfect match, we had small trouble with locating the place and it was tricky to check in but beside that it was very good 😊

description:
It is only a 5-minute walk to the metro, metrobus and other public transportation in the central location in Mecidiyeköy, Şişli. You can reach Taksim, Beşiktaş, the Bosphorus and historical buildings in this region in a maximum of 15-20 minutes by public transportation.

There are many cafes and restaurants, shopping malls, supermarkets and banks around.

reviews.text:
Excellent stay:) Great location, clean, calm and you get what exactly you see (same as the pictures)
Comfortable bed, well equipped kltchen, nicely decorated house. Ibrahim was friendly and attentive too. Great value for your money.

I came from London to Istanbul and I couldn’t access to my internet when I arrived to the airport. Ibrahim was so helpful and told me when I arrive to the address, we can meet up in Starbucks which was close to the address.

The apartment was so clean and very close to the amenities. You can easily buy your groceries in around your location. Also if you stay in Sunday your can buy fresh vegetables and food in local Sunday market which is located in the back street of the building.
Finally, this flat was peacefully wonderful and I felt at home.
Ev geniş , rahat ve temiz. Ev sahibi Ibrahim Bey çok ilgili ve nazik. Evin konumu ihtiyaciniz olabilecek herseye cok yakin ve en güzeli Istanbul gibi bir yerde eve ait park yeri var

İbrahim beyin evi resimlerde olduğu gibi. harika bir lokasyona sahip. evin kendine ait otoparkı olması ayrıca rahatlık sağlıyor. evin içine gelince; özenle seçilmiş eşyalar, harika bir temizlik ve ferah bir oturma alanı. isatnbula gelecek herkese tavsiye ederim. tam not aldı 👍 teşekkürler ibrahim bey
Çok ilgili ve yardım sever bir ev sahibi.Ev cok temiz ve donanımlı merkezi bir konumda

description: Enjoy your holiday with your family in our comfortable and luxuriously designed apartments in the center of Beyoğlu, where you can sleep while watching Istanbul and watch the unique view of the Golden Horn. We are waiting for our guests by combining history with modernity in our historical building where you will not have any transportation problems within walking distance of Taksim, Istiklal Street and Pera, which are the most famous places of Istanbul.

reviews.text: The pictures do not do justice. The apartment felt much bigger than the pictures. It was modern and super clean. Very convenient location as well (Istiklal Street was only a 10 walk). The host was very responsive and accommodating as well. We had an issue with our bathroom sink and shower. Someone was there within 20 minutes to fix it. Would 100% stay here again. The location was safe, clean, and the people were kind.

Öncelikle ev sahibi kesinlikle çok ilgili ve sorularınıza çok hızlı cevap veriyor. Ev fotoğraftakilerin birebir aynısı. Aksesuarlara kadar aynı ve tertemiz. Bina ve sahibi hakkında tek bir kötü düşüncemiz yok, teşekkür ediyoruz. 7/24 güvenlik var, bu sayede kendinizi rahat hissedebilirsiniz. Fakat beğenmediğimiz noktalara gelirsek, kesinlikle garaj 3 arabalık değil ve girmesi çıkması çok zor. Sedan bir arabaya sahiptik ve çıkarken resmen kaldırımla duvar arasında sıkıştık. Garaja girerken arabanın altı çarptı, bu sebeple seyehatimiz boyunca arabayı çıkartmaktan korktuk. Konumu çok güvenli olmayan bir muhitte. Kız kıza gelinecek olursa gece dönüşleriniz rahat hissettirmeyecektir. Geceleri kavga sesi, sabahları ise araba sesi çok gürültülü geliyor. Son olarak, evde halı bulunsa çok daha iyi olabilirdi ya da gerçek terlikler :( tek kullanımlık terliklerle evde gezmek zordu. Ayrıca mutfakta bulaşık makinesi bulunsa bulaşıkları temizlemek çok daha kolay olabilir.

The apartment is much bigger and even more beautiful than the photos. It was very clean, and the bedding was comfortable.
However, there are a few things I think future guests should know. The air conditioner is very noisy, even when it is turned off, and the constant noise made it difficult to sleep peacefully. There is also no dishwasher or coffee machine.
I have stayed in many Airbnb properties, and most of them provide a few basic essentials so guests don’t have to buy everything immediately. For example, there were no garbage bags, no small amount of laundry detergent for the first wash, and no kitchen paper towels. There was also only one bath towel per person, whereas most Airbnbs I’ve stayed in provide extra towels and spare bed sheets.
On the positive side, I really liked the small patio, having a TV in the bedroom, and the 24-hour security, which made us feel safe throughout our stay.

We had a very pleasant stay at NM Suites Apt in Istanbul. This modern apartment was even bigger than the photos, and both bedrooms had a beautiful sea view. All rooms are equipped with AC, which made the stay very comfortable. The 24/7 security, who welcomed us upon our arrival in the afternoon, added to the sense of safety and comfort. The location was excellent, within walking distance of Istiklal Street and Taksim Square. Highly recommended!

We had a great stay. Very close to Taksim Square and Istiklal Caddesi and yet far away enough from all the noise. We can see the Bosphorus from the windows of both rooms. Place is very clean and every room has an AC which is very important to us.
Check in was a breeze.Lobby staff are very friendly and helpful. Our flight to Cappadocia was in the evening and Okan allowed us to leave our luggage with them after checkout which we really appreciate. Thank you for a great experience.

description: Registered Licenced Spacious 2 Bedroom apartment in the hearth of Istanbul. The location of the apartment is walking distance to most of the touristic destinations and major public transportations like Metro, tram, bus and ferry. It is in a quiet, friendly and safe neighborhood. 환영

reviews.text:
I am in my late 50s, travelling with my wife and our adult child (early 20s) from Kuala Lumpur to Istanbul. We explored Istanbul extensively, then drove to charming smaller cities like Eskişehir and Bursa for a deeper taste of Turkey.
The apartment is situated on walkable terrain and is on the 2nd floor, accessible via a short flight of stairs and easy to manage with light luggage. Its prime location near the T1 tram line puts all of Istanbul at your doorstep, whether you’re heading to the European or Asian side.
The space includes all basic comforts, one room with a queen bed and another with a single bed. The host is committed to responding quickly to any questions or needs during our stay.
A special thanks to our wonderful host for allowing us a generous late check-out, which gave us plenty of time to prepare for our very early morning flight back to Kuala Lumpur.

BoRA Place was a fantastic experience. The combination of a prime location, a clean and well-equipped apartment, and the hospitality of our host made it a memorable trip to Istanbul.
BoRA was incredibly responsive to our messages, addressing any questions or concerns promptly. This level of communication gave us peace of mind throughout our stay.
The Place is conveniently situated near Galata Fort, making it the perfect starting point for exploring the historic heart of Istanbul. We were able to walk to many iconic landmarks, restaurants, and shops, which added so much value to our stay.
I would highly recommend BoRA Place to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay in this beautiful city. We can't wait to return

Excellent location, very close to tram and ferries, and a 5-minute walk to Galataport, where there are many excellent restaurants, clothes stores, and a grocery store.
Check- i was extremely easy, and the host was very responsive.
Very clean, comfortable apartment. Beds were very comfortable and clean.

Excellent apartment - spacious, cozy, and fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The location is fantastic, close to the metro and many attractions. It’s quiet at night, making it easy to get a good night’s sleep. The apartment was clean and well-maintained, and check-in was smooth. BoRa was always available and responded very quickly whenever we needed assistance. Highly recommended!

We were in Istanbul with my mother. We really enjoyed living in these apartments. Very convenient location and many cafes nearby. The apartment is fully consistent with the description, very clean and comfortable. The host is very responsive and attentive. Thank you for your hospitality, I will recommend to my friends!

description:
In the heart of history of İstanbul.
A special room for you. We alsa have a perfect terrace with a nice view.

reviews.text: Great accommodation, clean, easy to access, flexible check in times and you can get a daily room clean/make up if you wish. Great price. Only downside is the bars and restaurants surrounding the airbnb will hassle you to go into their bars EVERY time you go in and out. Not a fault of the hotel - just something to note about the area. It is a good location in terms of being near main sights and landmarks. Thank you!

One big plus is the location.
But the housing itself turned out to be worse than in the photographs.
And the bathroom door handle was really annoying! It fell off on the first day, after two attempts to open the door from the inside. My wife and I also opened the door for each other from the outside.
I was also disappointed that they provided very little toilet paper and shower accessories.
But all the downsides were outweighed by the location and the fact that you allowed us to move into the accommodation early.

Overall great stay, very central and at walking distance from the main attractions. Check in was smooth, no issues with our late check in either. The host was very kind and helped us with recommendations and transportation.
2 things to keep in mind, the street it’s located in a very busy street and there’s people trying to get you to come into their restaurants all the time, very annoying but not the hotel’s fault obviously.
And lastly, our bathroom door did not have a handle from the inside, so we had to holler to someone from the outside to open the bathroom door. This was the room for 3 people, not ideal at all. They need to fix that handle.
Otherwise pretty good stay, you get what you pay for.

We only stayed for 1 night. But it was great and the host was very helpful and responsive. Most of the major tourist attractions are very near. Sultan ahemed T1 tram station is just 250 to 300 meters away. A lot of restaurants in the street for food.
Bit of narrow 1 way street and is mostly crowed but considering proximity to majority of attractions it's value for money.

Literally 5-10 minutes away from the Ayasofiya, Blue Mosque and Basilica Cistern. This AirBnB/hotel was fantastic for what we needed. Clean, mostly private and most importantly, central to many locations including public transport.
It's on a busy street, full of life almost 24/7. Personally, we did not hear much, if at all during the night (simply the distant call to prayer).
The staff are attentive and regularly asked whether we needed extra towels or bed sheets changed. Upon check-out, the staff arranged a taxi to the airport for us at a reduced rate.
Would come here again! (We also recommend making a visit by Havana Bar and Hookah Lounge - the staff is amazingly friendly and welcoming).
Definitely consider this place and as location wise it is very convenient!

description:
The building is earthquake resistant.

Renovated by the architect owner, this historical house is located in the heart of the old city. The house is located in the Zeyrek Conservation Area, one of the four areas in the UNESCO World Heritage List of İstanbul. It is renovated again in April 2023. The house is recognized and protected as a historical monument.

We can arrange a transfer car from or to the airport in case you need it.

reviews.text: Comfortable stay for a few days in Istanbul. Shower pressure and temperature control was excellent! Beds very comfortable and clean (I usually check the mattress, it was pristine). There are stairs to go up (be mindful if you have a lot of heavy luggage). Public transport a bit of a walk away. Few handy convenience shops nearby, peaceful neighbourhood.

Fantastic stay !! The place was as described in the listing. Access to the location was easy. Nice cosy house.
Silan is a super-super-host. Accessible anytime. Helped a lot with recommendations and great places to visit / eat / shop.
Extremely satisfied with our stay and would recommend highly

Şilan and her brother Şıdar are an amazing host. Şılan has been very helpful with getting us an airport pick up and drop off with lots of recommendations to go for a good exchange and where to eat.
Her house is located in the old city and pretty peaceful to rest after a day out in busy Istanbul city. The neighbourhood offers more local experiences, definitely no tourist hustlers. Bus stops is just 5 mins walk and tram station about 10 to all the major attractions.
We are a family of 4 and the duplex is perfect! It is clean and has everything that we needed.
During our stay, we encountered a problem and both Şilan and Şidar came all the way to comfort us. They are like family in a foreign country which is a true gem 💎
4 days was not enough for us in Istanbul and we definitely will come again to stay with them.

Silan and her Brother Sidar have been very nice and helpful. They are available and have great communication. The apartment was clean and esthetically pleasant.
The only small drawback is the fact that there is a mosque nearby and sometimes it can get loud at night or very early in the morning. However, that might be true for almost any location in Istanbul., being closer to a mosque of course makes the noise louder. This was not a big problem for me and my friend, but if you're looking for peace, especially at night, keep this in mind. Silan and Sidar, thank you so so much <3

It was a pleasant stay for one week, Silan was very helpful and the building was as described, classic and warm. Suggest to buy from bigger supermarkets in city, the neighborhood restaurants and stores were not fair.

description: we tried to provide all hotel standards for your comfort and convenience.located among several large shopping centers in Istanbul.you are 5 to 10 min away from all shopping centers such as Water Garden, Emar Mall, Akasia, Metropol, and Optimum by car, and if there is no traffic, you have 20 minutes to the historical centers of the city, as well. It is 20 minutes away from Sabiha airport without traffic and 40 minutes away from the Istanbul airport.

reviews.text: The owners of the hotel, a wonderful couple, they were very responsive throughout the stay. You can see that the hotel is built with love, and it has a lot of effort, because the apartments were very comfortable, we found everything necessary for life-washer, kitchen utensils, towels and even a vacuum cleaner. Also, all the furniture was new, and whole design is very stylish, i really like that every room has special name and colour tones inside . This was my family’s rendezvous point, and we enjoyed our stay so much, we didn’t want to leave the rooms. I will recommend accommodation to all friends and will definitely return in the future. But keep in mind, the hotel has two cons - it’s bad internet and an uncomfortable location. Everything else is super.

a beautiful peaceful place , gorgeous, modern and spotless clean, very quiet and calm , we absolutely recommend , the bus station is in front of the building , other transportation means are just a walk away , I have nothing negative to say , I thank them for their professionalism, I would also recommend this to all my friends and familly who think of coming to Istanbul.
Otel olarak düzenlenmiş bir işletme fakat günlük yaşamda her türlü ihtiyacınızı karşılamak üzere hareket edilmiş. Rahat ve temizdi tavsiye ederim.
Very comfortable, thank you
Nice design of a room full of all what needed. It is like an excellent hotel. My only negative is the small bathroom otherwise, overall a nice place to stay

description:
Fully furnished, comfortable, authentic apartment in a historical building and old residential neighborhood of İstanbul; excellent location.
The cleanliness of the apartment before and after every tenant is my major concern. I try to be very helpful to my tenants on all issues.
5min to Şişhane subway, 3 min to bus stations, 10min to Tünel underground funicular and İstiklal Avenue by walking.
40min by car from Istanbul Airport (Outside of the rush hours) and 1:30hour by subway.

reviews.text:
Overall this is a good place to stay and I recommend it if you’re not looking for *the* perfect place, but still there are some points for improvement so it can be worth the value.
Good things:
1. Looks like the pictures, spacious and airy apartment that was very clean when we arrived
2. Wifi was reliable and we were able to work
3. The place is close to Taksim & transportation, though it requires some uphill walk
4. Super nice and responsive host
5. Equipped kitchen
Not so great:
1. Some appliances. Like the hairdryer does not heat up anymore, the dishwasher could not clean things 100%, the kettle leaked. Boiler leaks a lot too and we had to use buckets under it for half the stay because the hose in it stopped working
2. Uncomfy bed :( it sinks in the middle and hurt our backs
3. The building is very unclean like other reviews say. People leave things and trash in the lobby, and the building door won’t lock
4. You need to go to Taksim for good food and most groceries

I arrived early before check in time 2pm but the host arrived on time 2pm and hand over the apartment to me which i found clean and nice on 2nd floor , its an old building but the aprt. is renovated , the location is excellent in the center but away from the noise also near the main street where you find transportation easy even Metro station 10min walk , only the wifi was some time weak but the apartment fully furnished

We had an exceptional time in Istanbul. the location was just far enough from all the touristy areas that we could feel a local vibe. Everything is very accessible from the house.
The house was very clean and we appreciated the tea and cafe.
The bed was comfortable and they had hot and cold water.
Thanks for having us! Would highly recommend.
Xx

Apartment has everything you need:
- Excellent location ,close to the main road, Bus station, and around 7 mins walk to istiklal street.
- Comfy bed.
- All kitchen utensils.
- Quite street.
- Bright natural light with a nice view.
- Esra can solve any issue, she let us check in early, she bought a new fan when i told her it was hot in the room.
The Only cons:
-Second floor, no lift. -old building.

Great location, cozy apartment, quiet neighborhood (there is a school and stadium around the corner though but to they didn't bother much), You have to climb 2 flights of stairs there so might not be convenient for some travelers. The flat has all that you need for a comfy stay (kitchen, washing machine, hair dryer, wifi). We were a bit cold at the beginning of our stay because there is no central heating in the building however with a couple of radiators provided the rooms got warmer soon and we were fine.
Thanks for hosting us, Esra!

description: Experience an unforgettable stay in one of the most beautiful streets of Cihangir, the ideal address to discover the soul of Istanbul, in this newly renovated apartment with the highest quality furnishings. With a fully equipped kitchen, elegant bedrooms and modern bathroom, your comfort has been thought of. Close to the lively atmosphere of Cihangir and famous attractions, this apartment awaits you for an unforgettable Istanbul vacation.

reviews.text: Great location, responsive hosts. Apartment matched photos and description. Good air conditioning and water pressure. Washing machine perfect. Needs more tender loving care such as updated linens and deeper cleaning.

Absolutely worth every penny spent at this spot !
The location was within walking distance of taksim (10 mins). Theres also a few cafes within a couple of mins or less of walking. Amazing breakfast spots and lots quirky cafes to dine at. The apartment is clean with everything you could possibly need. Everything from coffee , tea, detergent, shampoo, soap , clean towels and extra sheets were available for us.
The host Irfan was lovely and recomemded places for us to try and was always available to assist.
The street was easily accesible and not to steep. There were a few steps to climb but nothing too hard. My 65 year old mother had no trouble.
The spot is wonderful and i absolutely recommend it. Thank you the Irfan and the team for a truly memorable stay 🙏

Wonderful Airbnb apartment in a dynamic location where the cafes, restaurants and bars are right outside your door. It's also a few minutes walk to Taksim square, Istiklal street and a downhill walk to Galataport.
The apartment itself is quiet, private and safe. The bed is really comfortable with its extra large pillows. The bathroom is tight, but adequate and clean enough.
Enjoy Istanbul.
Wonderful apartment and host! Space was clean and well equipped. Neighborhood is walkable and full of little cafes and shops. We will stay again!

I had a great time at Lemon apartments. This apartment is on the bottom floor, with east entry and self check in. It felt very secure. Cihangir is a beautiful neighbourhood, the best in Istanbul I think with plenty to do day and night. Some of the best food is available, 5 mins walk in every direction. Public transport is very easy from this apartment to all corners of Istanbul with access to tram, train and boat. Highly recommend staying here ;)

description: This stylish place is close to must-see destinations.

reviews.text:
Overall we were happy in the accommodation, but I have to divide my review for each of the rooms separately. We were two couples in two rooms.
Room 202 - nice, clean, small but enough room to put our suitcase away, clean and comfortable bed, clean shower, quiet fridge. This room I highly recommend.
Room 203 - it was also clean with comfortable bed BUT there was only small window which didn’t lead anywhere (to porthole) which means you couldn’t let fresh air into the room. Which meant it was too hot during the nights or - if you started the AC - too cold. Our friends are leaving with a sore throat because of it. It would be nice to be able to choose what room you have (with/without the window). Also the water from shower was all over the bathroom because of the missing gradient on the shower floor.
The receptionists were always nice and very helpful and accommodating. The hotel was in the city center very near to restaurants and main historical attractions.

The place is nice and on a good location however the owner Vedat wasnt very acomodating and rather deciving. we booked this place at last minute as our previoust host canceleed the reservation upon arrival.
by mistake we booked one extra nite with Vedat. however,next morning as soon as woke up I requested a change of reservation for one day less. Vedat didnt replied and I had to remind him. he said he would give me cash isntead of accepting the request but of course in that case I would lose the cleaning fees, air b and bs comision and taxes. I explained there wasnt a need for that, all he had to do was to accept my request and air b and b would take care of the rest. he got upset and decided no to give me the cash back. when contacted again, he said the only way he could give the cash was when I placed a good revied for him. in that case i would be gone unable to collect the cash as I was to fly one day beofre the end of the reservation. I found him deceiving untrustworthy

This host and everyone else who works at the hotel are extremely nice, welcoming and helpful! This place is located at a great spot with all attractions being within walkable distance and the tram station right by it. We had a great experience!!

We booked a joining room which as just as seen on the photos , but the main door was not lockable .
Bathroom doors were broken . In the single bedroom the air con could do with being looked at it was very hot in there .
Also we experienced noise from next door building hammering started at 9.30pm and continued till midnight , phoned reception but no answer so had to go down to speak to night reception who at that time was not there . Whist doing this drilling then started .
Receptionist appeared and said he had been to see them and was assured will be finished in 5/10 minutes so by 12.20 all was quiet until then I think they had a party .
I messaged my host who was prompt and apologised and reassured me the rest of our stay would be noise free .
In which it was .
Good location but crowded area, the host are friendly, and clean rooms

description:
Interior room facing a very small courtyard rather than the street. The view is of neighboring walls, so the room receives almost no natural sunlight.

New on June 26, 2026: a Yataş Prestige Premium Ultra Firm Orthopedic Mattress (valued at $480 USD).

A simple, functional, budget-friendly room in an excellent central location for solo travelers and backpackers.

Best suited for experienced Airbnb guests with a positive track record. If you're new to Airbnb, please check my other listings.

reviews.text: The location was perfect, the room is great value for the money (not even as small as I imagined), Burak comunicated really well. Check-in was easy and well described, the flat was overall clean and cozy. Felt like home!

Burak communicated extremely well throughout my stay; his instructions for check-in and general housekeeping were very helpful and clear. I met him as I checked in and he was warm and welcoming. His place is very charming and comfortable. The bedroom was modern, cosy and clean. It was also quiet. WiFi worked well in the room. The shared bathrooms were kept clean and the shower room had a washing machine. The kitchen was clean and had plenty of amenities. The location was perfect for me with plenty of cafes, restaurants and shops around; it really is in the heart of sweet Kadikoy. The ferry and metro are about a 10-minute walk. I would gladly stay here if I returned to Istanbul.

Burak is a cool host!
the location is great if u're up to live busy locations, maybe not so great if u prefer calm and quiet vibes.
apartment is equipped with everything u might need for longer stay (washing machine, dryer, stove, refrigerator etc )
there are 4 rooms, one bathroom with the toilet, one more toilet and a small kitchen. Two toilets is a good thing especially if there are 4 people living at the same time.
disadvantages:
- the smallest room doesn't have ANY natural light (to be fair, Burak told me about it before the reservation, so it was kinda my choice 😅)
- the apartment doesn't have a common area, where you can chill with other flatmates. well we still managed to socialize in a small kitchen, but yes some kind of livingroom was missing.
- check in is quite late 3 pm and check out is quite early 10 am (this sucks!)
other than that, u will get more or less what u see in photos. Burak, thank u for hosting! 🤝
Burak is an excellent host, the apartment is in a great location. It's a great deal for the price and quality. The only downsides are the uncomfortable bed and the fact that the room was a bit dirty.

The location is amazingly convenient and central. As my room was not facing the busy bar street like other rooms, noise wasn't a big problem for me. There's no air conditioner so note that if you are travelling in summer. The room, kitchen, bathrooms were all very tidy and clean. The apartment had very comfy atmosphere. The communication with Burak before arrival was smooth and clear. I did self check in and met him on my second day, then he made sure everything is alright and shared some recommendations around. I appreciate how he took care for the whole process.

description:
The apartment is in the 23 floor , with a perfect view. It is a perfect place for family members and its only takes one minute walk to go to super market and to restaurants and coffee shops.All our houses are 100 meters from the metro station.
And if you are a big fan of shopping you can visit 212 outlet shopping Mall, And Mall of Istanbul the biggest Mall of Turkey, where you can find everything you wish for.

reviews.text:
Overall, everything was perfect, or even better than we expected!
The house was as comfortable and clean as in the photo.
Nice location and walking distance to public transport.
Everything was as it appeared in the photos.
For the first time, we were able to say that we would prefer it again for our stay in Istanbul if the vacuum cleaner works again! ;)
Thank you VARLI GROUP for your friendly hosting! 🌸🌸

Ev fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Çok düzenli ve temizdi. Ev sahibi de bizimle çok iyi ilgilendi. Tabak,bardak,çatal gibi şeyler azdı biz 6 kişi konakladigimiz için o konuda biraz sıkıntı çektik. Onun dışında her şey mükemmeldi.
Great place and clean beds sheets it needs some maintenance lights some of them not working and the some of walls need to be painted again but overall it is ok

The Ac wasn’t cooling the entire room, you had to wait 3-4 hours for it to cool the entire room. There were not enough sleeping spaces for 6 people, we requested extra towels and bedding but they were not provided.

It was very pleasant to stay in this appartment. The place was neet and well kept. All the facilities were there to make our stay a very enjoifull one. Sumaya was very responsive and quicly reactive. The place was very secured and the environment was excellent specilly when you are travelling with your family. Congratulations to Varli Group. We pray to come back again and again.

description: Welcome to our urban oasis loft in the heart of Balat! Beautifully designed 1-bedroom home offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and historic charm. Whether you're a solo traveler, a couple seeking a romantic getaway, or here on business, this stylish retreat is the ideal base for exploring Istanbul's rich history and vibrant culture. Premium linens and a cozy bed. Relax in the living room and channel your inner chef in a fully equipped kitchen. Comes with AC and Wifi.

reviews.text:
Overall we were fairly satisfied with our stay. The apartment is tastefully decorated and the neighbourhood has its charm. Although the street is quite busy with tourists, this wasn't a major problem during the daytime and generally it's quiet on an evening (apart from a noisy electricity generator).
The main problems however, were the construction project happening directly opposite (from 8:30am - 18:00pm most days).
The windows are not sound proofed for this kind of noise and made our first few days uncomfortable. There are also some details of the property that needed some care (damaged floor, broken shower holder downstairs, poor lighting in the kitchen near the sink and so on).
Although the hosts attended to any problems quite quickly, I felt all of these issues affected our enjoyment and didn't truly reflect the value of the property. The area itself is very overpriced, but the one redeeming factor is that it's close to the tram and getting into the centre is very easy.

First of all, I want to thank the host for allowing me to check in at 1:00 PM. At first glance, the apartment looks good and has everything you need. But elevator wasn’t working.
Another downside of this apartment is the poor window soundproofing. Noise from the very busy street outside constantly fills the room until late evening. On the second floor, the bedroom can get stuffy and hot — the fan doesn’t help.
As for the street vibe — that’s a whole different story. The charm wears off quickly. All the sidewalks are taken over by tables from various cafes with pushy staff trying to lure you in. You’re forced to walk on the road, where cars and scooters are constantly driving by, making any walk extremely unpleasant.
Bottom line: if you enjoy living in constant noise and chaos, this is the place for you. But if you’re looking to come home and relax in peace and quiet — stay far away from this apartment!
And in my opinion, the price is way too high — it’s not worth it. Good luck!

We stayed for two weeks and overall had a very good experience. The apartment is really spacious for two people and has all the amenities needed, especially for laundry. The A/C works well, and the location in Balat is great, with unique cafés and restaurants nearby. Sultanahmet and Galata are also walkable — around 40 minutes, but it’s a nice walk.
A few things could be improved: the lights are quite dim at night, the Wi-Fi can occasionally be unreliable, and the bed was a little too soft for our preference. The loft shower heater also wasn’t working very well, and a chopping board would be a useful addition to the kitchen. The lift wasn’t working during our stay, so be prepared for stairs if you have large luggage. There can also be occasional noise at night, although it didn’t bother us.
Overall, a comfortable stay with plenty of space and a great location. The pros definitely outweighed the cons.

Everything was as it was described. Kitchen is decently equipped and modern. It's pretty larger inside than I have thought. Especially the communication with the VNG Property was good. They are helpful and giving fast responses. You have everything you need in the flat. Only thing people should be aware of is that the internet is not the fastest. It is still functioning, no connection loss and speed is okay (24 mbps stable internet). I just wanted to mention it for people who need high speed internet for work. Everything was perfect.

This is one of the best apartments I have ever stayed in in terms of price and quality.
The ceilings are very high, the space was sparkling clean and professionally maintained, and the apartment is furnished with beautiful, high-quality furniture. The bed is exceptionally large and soft, with premium bedding that made it extremely comfortable to sleep.
The apartment was very warm and cozy overall.
It is absolutely worth every euro, and I will definitely stay here again when I return to Istanbul.
The support team was professional, responsive, and always ready to help with any request.
Truly one of my best Airbnb experiences — I highly recommend it 😊!
